title: Agentic Platform Engineer (gn) @ AI Venture, Berlin
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture 

AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up.

Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around.

We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task.

Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one.

Our founder brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. Backed by Atlantic at pre-seed, we are growing the engineering team to bring the product into production, with people already waiting to use it.

About the Role 

As one of our first platform engineers, you will build the foundations that every product feature depends on: the gateway and router, usage and billing systems, customer key management and the European infrastructure underneath.

Much of that platform is still taking shape. Working directly with the founder, CTO and founding AI engineer, you will help turn early architectural decisions into systems that remain reliable as the product grows.

You will take capabilities from design through to production, thinking through their APIs, failure modes, deployment, observability and ongoing operation. In a team this small, building and running the system belong together. You will also work alongside our founding AI engineer on evals, embeddings and open-weight model serving, bringing platform engineering depth to the ML side of the product.

Agentic engineering is central to how we work. You will operate in an agentic way by default, using coding agents as a core part of how you design, build, test and ship software. You'll develop the harnesses and workflows that allow you to delegate and parallelise work effectively, increasing what a small engineering team can deliver. This requires strong coding fundamentals and the judgement to review, challenge and take responsibility for everything that reaches production.

There is a lot to build and an ambitious timeline ahead. We work with intensity, move quickly from decisions to execution and value people who take initiative and see things through.

What You’ll Work On 

Your first area of ownership will depend on your strengths and our priorities. From there, you will contribute across the platform as it develops.

- Gateway and routing: build a consistent API across model providers, with reliable streaming, fallbacks and safe handling of retries and provider errors.

- Agentic engineering workflows: build and refine the harnesses, tooling and workflows that enable coding agents to work effectively across the development lifecycle, from implementation and testing to debugging and deployment.

- Cost optimisation: develop caching, history compression and model selection, measuring savings while keeping estimated costs distinct from actual spend.

- Usage and billing: build accurate accounting for model calls, usage reports, plan entitlements and invoice reconciliation.

- Agent infrastructure and integrations: support tool calls, cost limits, human approvals and runs that can recover safely from interruptions, alongside connectors for services such as Gmail, Slack and calendars.

- Tenancy and secrets: maintain workspace isolation, secure authentication and encrypted customer key management.

- European infrastructure and model serving: build and operate our cloud infrastructure, including the GPU capacity used to serve open-weight models.

- Production reliability: make systems observable, migrations reversible and releases safe, with tests that protect data integrity and logs that keep customer content and secrets private.

The platform will evolve quickly. You will need to move comfortably between improving what exists and learning enough about a new problem to build the next piece well.

Our Stack 

Our backend is built in Python, with a TypeScript frontend in a shared monorepo.

- Backend: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic and LiteLLM.

- Data and queues: Postgres with row-level security and pgvector, Redis and arq.

- Frontend: Next.js , React and TypeScript.

- Cloud and infrastructure: Scaleway, Terraform and Kubernetes for GPU workloads.

- Auth and secrets: Zitadel, Secret Manager and KMS.

- Observability and testing: OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, Sentry, pytest and testcontainers, alongside frontend testing tools.

You should be comfortable with the core backend technologies and ready to learn the rest as the work requires.

About You 

You enjoy the craft of engineering and the responsibility of seeing your work used in production. Faced with an unclear problem, you can identify what matters, make sensible trade-offs and carry a solution through to release without someone planning every step. You naturally look for ways to multiply your output through agentic workflows, rather than approaching every engineering task as something to execute manually.

We are looking for:

- Experience building and operating production systems: several years of backend engineering with real users, typically three to six, and meaningful ownership of what you shipped.

- Strong Python fundamentals: confidence with async code, typing and testing. TypeScript experience is a plus.

- Agentic engineering as a default way of working: you have hands-on experience using coding agents as a core part of your engineering workflow. You know how to break down problems, delegate and parallelise tasks, provide the right context and build effective agentic workflows. Crucially, you have the technical depth to review, debug and take ownership of the resulting code.

- Platform engineering depth: practical experience with Postgres, Redis, queues, networking and Terraform. Kubernetes experience is useful, particularly for our GPU infrastructure.

- Sound engineering judgement: clear APIs, tenant isolation, data integrity, partial failure and safe rollouts. You can explain both your decisions and what you chose to leave out.

- A working understanding of ML systems: familiarity with LLMs, embeddings, evals, model serving and fine-tuning. Experience with LLM APIs, streaming and token costs is a strong plus.

- A disciplined approach to measurement: you benchmark changes, question assumptions and use evidence to understand whether an improvement holds up.

- Initiative and drive: you enjoy getting deep into a problem, finding a way forward and putting in the work to make it happen.

- This is an experienced individual-contributor role, with ownership of the capabilities you build and close collaboration across the founding team.

- Fluent English is required; German is a plus.

Why Join 

At this stage, platform engineering decisions have a direct influence on the product and how quickly the team can build it. You will work close to the founder and CTO, with room to shape the systems you own and see the results of your work first-hand.

The challenge spans AI infrastructure, distributed systems, security and cost efficiency. You will build across those boundaries, take real responsibility early and receive a meaningful equity package in the company you help develop.

We are competing with teams that have more people, more funding and an earlier start. Our approach depends on technical depth, focused decisions and the drive to turn them into working software. We believe agentic engineering can fundamentally change what a small, technically strong team is capable of building, and we're looking for people who want to push that approach forward. For someone who enjoys a demanding build, close collaboration and visible impact, there is a lot to get involved in.

This is a full-time role, based in our Berlin office five days a week, starting as soon as possible.

title: Design Engineer, Site
description:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.

We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.

Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.

About the role 

We’re looking for an exceptional Design Engineer (Site) to own https://infisical.com and show the world what we're about.

In this role, you'll work with engineering, design, and marketing to be the go-to person for everything having to do with building and maintaining the design and infrastructure of the landing page; we want this surface to be iconic and performant to drive organic traffic and user adoption.

This role is for someone who has a frontend-leaning full stack engineering background, who obsesses over crafting pixel-perfect experiences, cares about building sound underlying infrastructure, and is motivated to help build out our growth engine.

You'll work closely with our co-founder, engineering, design, and marketing to:

- 
Design and ship pixel-perfect, reusable components and complex designs.

- 
Build and maintain core website pages (home, product, blogs, learning/resource hub etc.), microsites, frontend architecture, code quality, CMS integration and experience.

- 
Implement SEO best practices, run A/B tests, and optimize conversion funnels.

- 
Integrate analytics, attribution, and marketing tooling - Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, HubSpot, etc.

Requirements 

- 
Deep mastery of JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, TypeScript, and frameworks like React/Next.js.

- 
Experience building high-quality frontend systems and components with strong attention to performance, accessibility, and maintainability.

- 
Experience with web design and design systems.

- 
Exceptional attention to detail and eagerness to learn.

- 
Bias toward action: able to make decisions, iterate quickly, and take calculated risks.

- 
Based in the Americas (SF preferred) or able to work EST hours.

Nice to have 

- 
Technical SEO fundamentals.

- 
Experience with CMS platforms (e.g. Contentful, Sanity, etc.).

- 
Experience configuring website analytics/marketing platform integrations such as with Google Analytics and HubSpot.

- 
Experience with developer-facing products or startups.

Team, values & benefits 

Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page .

title: QA Engineer
description:
QA Engineer (Web, App & Payments)

Hybrid 
Amsterdam, Noord-Holland, Netherlands
Technology 

Job description

About Us

Creative Clicks is a leading global marketing agency with offices worldwide and 200+ professionals. Since 2009, we've been empowering brands, publishers, and marketers to attract and engage customers at scale with cutting-edge technology and creativity. We live by our Triple E philosophy: Energetic, Entrepreneurial, Experts. And our motto: One team. One dream.

The Role

We're looking for a QA Engineer to own quality across our web funnels, mobile app, and payment flows. In this role, you are the last line of defence before every release: you decide whether we ship, and you make sure fast iteration never comes at the cost of a broken checkout or a stuck subscription.

You'll work hand in hand with our backend, frontend, and Flutter developers, as well as the Funnel Ops team, to validate critical user journeys, reproduce the edge cases nobody else can, and steadily replace manual checks with automation. This is an AI-enabled role: you'll use AI tooling to generate test cases, speed up bug reproduction, and write automation scripts, so you spend more time on the hard problems and less on repetition.

Key Responsibilities

- Own release QA: build test plans and regression suites, and make the go/no-go call for every release.

- Validate our critical flows end to end: onboarding, paywalls, checkout, payments, and subscription state transitions.

- Reproduce and document bugs clearly, coordinate fixes with engineering, and verify resolutions before they ship.

- Grow our automation coverage: automate repetitive tests, maintain release checklists, and drive down escaped defects.

- Classify bug severity and set the escalation path within QA's scope.

- Document QA processes and playbooks in Confluence so quality practices scale with the team.

- Use AI-enabled tooling to accelerate test coverage, bug reproduction, and scripting.

Job requirements

What We're Looking For

You are structured but pragmatic. You like breaking things on purpose, you don't sign off on something you haven't seen work, and you stay calm when a release is on the line.

Must-haves: 

- 3+ years of experience in QA or test engineering for web and/or mobile products.

- Hands-on experience testing payment and subscription flows with modern providers (Stripe, Adyen, PayPal, or similar): checkout, card and wallet payments, 3DS, trials, renewals, cancellations, refunds, and working with test modes and webhooks.

- Experience building automated UI tests with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar, in JavaScript/TypeScript. Able to investigate unstable runs, fix flaky tests, and tell a broken test from a broken product.

- Experience testing mobile applications (including Flutter) and web applications in browsers and in-app browsers, using real device clouds such as BrowserStack or LambdaTest.

- Comfortable working with APIs and verifying behaviour through data: REST and GraphQL, querying services and admin tools, and checking analytics events.

- Strong bug reporting skills: clear reproduction steps, severity assessment, and root-cause thinking.

- Comfortable making and defending release readiness decisions with engineering and product stakeholders; experience in cross-functional teams with frequent releases.

- Professional working proficiency in English, written and spoken.

Nice-to-haves: 

- Analytics and event verification: Mixpanel, Klaviyo, Google Analytics, Meta Pixel.

- Familiarity with products where a web funnel sells a subscription plus upsells, with content delivered via mobile and web apps. Experience with quiz-based funnels and performance marketing traffic.

- CI and reporting: Jenkins or GitHub Actions, Allure, or similar.

- Experience running load tests.

- Experience using AI assistants for test generation, debugging, and QA workflows.

What Makes You Successful Here

At Creative Clicks, our top performers:

- Take initiative and ownership.

- Focus on solutions, not obstacles.

- Stay grounded, even under pressure.

- Collaborate closely with their teams.

- Continuously deepen their expertise to inspire others.

What We Offer

- A highly dynamic and fast-growing working environment.

- An international company with more than 25 nationalities.

- Competitive salary and fully paid commuting expenses.

- 25 days of annual leave (plus the option to buy 10 more), with a healthy work-life balance and hybrid work setup.

- A place to learn, discover, and develop yourself.

- Warm daily lunch in the office.

- A fun, ambitious, and young team of colleagues.

- A recently renovated, beautiful office just 2 minutes from Leidseplein in Amsterdam.

Creative Clicks is proud to be a diverse and equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. Selection decisions are solely based on job-related factors.

Apply Now 

Ready to be the reason our releases ship with confidence? Apply now and join us at Creative Clicks.

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer – AI & Automation in Hamburg oder Remote (m/w/d)
description:
Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft intelligenter Prozessautomatisierung 
Du bist ein erfahrener Softwareentwickler, denkst gerne über einzelne Features hinaus und hast Lust, mit KI, Automatisierung und modernen Technologien echte Probleme zu lösen? Du möchtest nicht nur Anforderungen umsetzen, sondern selbst technische Lösungen gestalten und deine Erfahrung in ein interdisziplinäres Team einbringen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Deine Rolle bei uns
In unserem Team Elbe arbeiten Menschen mit unterschiedlichen fachlichen und technischen Hintergründen gemeinsam daran, Geschäftsprozesse intelligenter, effizienter und zunehmend automatisiert zu gestalten.
Wir entwickeln Automatisierungen, verbinden bestehende Systeme, erschließen neue Einsatzmöglichkeiten für künstliche Intelligenz und schaffen Lösungen, die unseren Kolleginnen und Kollegen sowie unseren Kunden die tägliche Arbeit erleichtern.
Dabei setzen wir auf einen pragmatischen Mix aus Low-Code-/No-Code-Plattformen, KI-gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen und klassischer Softwareentwicklung.
Als erfahrener Full-Stack Developer bringst du die technische Expertise mit, um unser Team auf das nächste Level zu heben. Du entwickelst selbst, übernimmst Verantwortung für Architekturentscheidungen und unterstützt deine Teamkollegen dabei, technisch immer eigenständiger zu werden.

Das erwartet dich 

- Softwareentwicklung und Architektur: Du konzipierst und entwickelst eigenständig Anwendungen, Services, APIs und Integrationen – vom technischen Entwurf bis zum produktiven Betrieb.

- Intelligente Prozessautomatisierung: Du entwickelst bestehende Automatisierungen weiter und setzt neue Lösungen um, beispielsweise mit n8n, APIs und individuell entwickelten Komponenten.

- KI sinnvoll einsetzen: Du integrierst KI-Modelle in bestehende Prozesse, entwickelst KI-gestützte Anwendungen und experimentierst mit neuen Technologien und Werkzeugen.

- Systeme miteinander verbinden: Du sorgst dafür, dass unterschiedliche Plattformen und Anwendungen zuverlässig miteinander kommunizieren und Daten sicher ausgetauscht werden.

- Technische Verantwortung übernehmen: Du triffst fundierte Architekturentscheidungen und achtest auf Wartbarkeit, Skalierbarkeit, Sicherheit und Qualität.

- Wissen teilen und gemeinsam wachsen: Du unterstützt deine Kollegen bei technischen Herausforderungen, führst sie an professionelle Entwicklungspraktiken heran und etablierst gemeinsam mit ihnen nachhaltige Lösungen.

- Eigenständig Lösungen schaffen: Du reduzierst technische Abhängigkeiten zu anderen Entwicklungsteams, indem du notwendige Komponenten selbst entwickelst und bestehende Schnittstellen sinnvoll nutzt.

Das bringst du mit 

- Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise im Full-Stack-Umfeld.

- Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Konzeption und Entwicklung moderner Softwarearchitekturen.

- Erfahrung mit Backend-Technologien, APIs, Datenbanken und der Integration unterschiedlicher Systeme.

- Kenntnisse in modernen Frontend-Technologien und die Fähigkeit, bei Bedarf vollständige Anwendungen eigenständig umzusetzen.

- Erfahrung mit Softwarequalität, Testing, Versionsverwaltung, CI/CD und dem Betrieb produktiver Anwendungen.

- Interesse an KI-Technologien, LLMs, AI-assisted Development und Automatisierungsplattformen.

- Die Fähigkeit, technische Herausforderungen pragmatisch zu lösen und dabei auch langfristige Anforderungen im Blick zu behalten.

- Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben, andere zu befähigen und gemeinsam technische Lösungen zu entwickeln.

Besonders wichtig ist uns deine Einstellung: Du musst nicht jedes Framework kennen. Viel wichtiger ist, dass du dich schnell in neue Technologien einarbeiten kannst, gerne Verantwortung übernimmst und Freude daran hast, in einem Team mit unterschiedlichen Kompetenzprofilen zu arbeiten. 
Unsere Aufgaben sind vielfältig und reichen von kleinen Automatisierungen bis zu komplexeren technischen Lösungen. 

Damit beschäftigst du dich beispielsweise: 

- Automatisierung von Geschäftsprozessen und Datenverarbeitung, beispielsweise rund um Vermittler- und Vertragsdaten.

- Entwicklung und Erweiterung von Schnittstellen zwischen unserer Maklerplattform Professional Works und externen Anwendungen.

- KI-gestützte Verarbeitung und Auswertung von Gesprächstranskripten, einschließlich automatisierter Zusammenfassungen und Coaching-Ansätzen.

- Integration von Kommunikations-, Support- und Marketingplattformen in automatisierte Workflows.

- Entwicklung interner Werkzeuge für Reporting, Datenanalyse und operative Prozesse.

- Technische Weiterentwicklung und Stabilisierung unserer Automatisierungslandschaft..

Dabei entscheidest du gemeinsam mit dem Team, wann eine bestehende Automatisierungsplattform die beste Lösung ist und wann individuell entwickelte Software den größeren Mehrwert bietet.

Warum diese Rolle besonders ist 

- Bei uns erwartet dich kein klassisches Entwicklungsteam, in dem ausschließlich Softwareentwickler sitzen und Tickets abarbeiten.

- Du arbeitest mit Kollegen zusammen, die Geschäftsprozesse verstehen, Automatisierungen entwickeln, KI-Werkzeuge einsetzen und neue Ideen schnell ausprobieren.

- Du ergänzt dieses Team um fundierte Softwareentwicklungs- und Architekturkompetenz.

- Dein Erfolg zeigt sich deshalb nicht nur an dem Code, den du selbst schreibst, sondern auch daran, wie viel leistungsfähiger und eigenständiger das gesamte Team durch deine Arbeit wird.

- Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, Technologien mitzugestalten, neue Ansätze auszuprobieren und unmittelbar zu erleben, welchen Unterschied deine Lösungen im Unternehmen machen.

Benefits 

- Eine sympathische Unternehmenskultur mit reiner Duz-Kultur und einem freundschaftlichen Miteinander

- Eine attraktive Vergütung und eine fundierte und individuelle Einarbeitung

- Agiles Arbeiten und flache Hierarchien

- Zahlreiche Mitarbeiter-Rabatte sowie Fahrtkostenzuschuss und bAV-Zuschuss

- Mitarbeiter-Events (Sommerfest/ Weihnachtsfeier)

title: Director of Go-to-Market Engineering
description:
About Us 

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem .

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role 

We are hiring our first Director of Go-to-Market Engineering .

Perk's revenue organisation is 800 people selling to more than 10,000 companies. Behind them sits a CRM, an enrichment and signal stack, a growing set of AI agents - and a lot of manual work that no longer needs to exist. Your job is to remove it and to build the automated systems that replace it.

You will own GTM Engineering end-to-end: which tools we use, how the architecture fits together, what gets built, and what it does for revenue. You report to the VP of Revenue Operations , lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter.

This is a player-coach role, and we mean it. You will be in Clay, in the orchestration logic, in the agent workflows, building alongside a team doing the same. You're using your experience to guide and coach them to accelerate the pace.

The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV.

What You'll Do 

Own the strategy and the stack 

- Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together.

- Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself.

- Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams.

- Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback.

Build, hands-on 

- Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production.

- Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails.

- Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely.

- Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript.

Automate across SDR, AE, and AM 

- Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution.

- Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds.

- Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning.

- Take each project from prototype to production properly - instrumented and validated before it scales.

Bridge commercial and technical 

- Turn commercial problems into technical architecture, and technical output into impact a revenue VPs recognises.

- Understand Perk's revenue goals and how to leverage AI capabilities for us to achieve them quicker and more efficiently.

- Understand and drive clear and tangible commercial outcomes. For example, how to reduce the time that quota-carrying roles spend on non-core activities such as account research, be able to quantify the impact, and clearly communicate the outcomes to leadership.

Build the team 

- Lead and grow a small, senior team across Europe and North America.

- Set clear ownership, and the review discipline that makes shipping fast also means shipping safely.

- Grow the team's technical depth and commercial judgement in equal measure.

What Will Make You Successful 

Experience 

- Deep background across Revenue Operations, GTM Engineering, Sales Systems, Growth Engineering, or an adjacent technical commercial function in B2B SaaS

- Proven track record in GTM Engineering specifically, with delivery at real scale — systems hundreds of sellers relied on, not a pilot for one team

- Time as both a builder and a leader. This role needs both.

Technical craft 

- Clay expertise in production - complex tables, waterfall enrichment, webhook integrations and AI column logic that revenue teams actually depended on.

- Deep Salesforce fluency: the data model, integration patterns, and where the constraints really are.

- Working proficiency in code — Python, SQL, SOQL, TypeScript or equivalent. You pull your own data. Not all coding languages are necessary, but proficiency in one or some is required.

- Architecture instincts: you build for scale, monitoring and recovery, not just for the first successful run.

- Depth across several layers of the modern GTM stack - enrichment and data (Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Cognism, PredictLeads), signal and intent (6sense, Bombora, UserGems), sequencing (Outreach, Salesloft), orchestration (n8n, Make, Workato), data infrastructure (Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery) and LLM and agent tooling. Nobody has all of it. We care that you have real depth somewhere and can learn the rest quickly.

Commercial instinct 

- You judge your work by whether it moved a commercial metric, not by whether it shipped.

- You have the credibility with Sales leaders to scope the right build - and to say when automation is the wrong answer.

- You understand the funnel end to end: TAM, ICP, pipeline generation, conversion, expansion, and the economics underneath.

Nice to have 

- Having stood up a GTM engineering function at a high-growth SaaS business, ideally above $100M ARR.

- Experience taking an automation programme from pilot to global production, including what you learned when it got bumpy.

- Multi-region GTM experience across EMEA and North America.

Why This Role 

GTM Engineering is a discipline being written right now, and most companies are still treating it as a tooling function. This is the chance to own it properly, the stack, the architecture, the build, and the commercial outcome across a $300M+ revenue business with 800 people in the field, a genuine appetite for automation, and the budget and executive backing to move fast.

You would be the first person in this seat, with real systems and real data to work with rather than a blank page, and the freedom to decide what Perk's automation layer should look like. There is a lot to go after, the problems are interesting, and the impact is immediate and visible.

If you want to build the automation layer of a commercial engine at this scale and you want to still have your hands on it come and build it here.

AI at Perk 
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work 

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com , and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Argentina Remote

Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.

About the Role 

We’re looking for a S enior Infrastructure Engineer to improve reliability and stability of Webflow’s customer-facing, production infrastructure, serving millions of page views per hour. Our product is used by over 2 million users world-wide across 190 countries, and you’ll help ensure our platform is secure and scalable for these users as tens of thousands of projects are launched on Webflow each month.

- Location: Remote-first (Argentina)

- Permanent, full-time employee (this is not a contractor position)

- Application Information:

- Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled

- This posting is for a new position.

As an Senior Infrastructure Engineer you will:

- Own and evolve the cloud platform that Webflow's product and engineering teams depend on, including our compute layer, EKS fleet, serverless infrastructure, networking, and cloud operations across AWS and GCP.

- Help design and maintain our infrastructure-as-code foundation, evolving the patterns and shared components other teams build on.

- Design and maintain the networking layer that connects Webflow's services, ensuring reliability, security, and scalability across our cloud environments.

- Help make observability data the foundation of how we operate, improving the dashboards, alerts, and SLOs for the infrastructure you own so that issues are caught before customers notice, and on-call pages are actionable instead of noisy.

- Build and maintain AI-powered automation that improves how we manage cloud infrastructure, from policy-as-code and drift detection to LLM-assisted runbook generation.

- Help define the culture of this growing team as it expands its international presence.

About you 

You’ll thrive as a Senior Infrastructure Engineer if you:

- Have a background as an infrastructure, site reliability engineer or cloud engineer with an enthusiasm for automation and code, or a background as a software engineer with deep enthusiasm for cloud infrastructure and distributed systems. 

- Have 5+ years of experience owning and operating cloud infrastructure in a customer-facing environment that allows for little to no downtime.

- Have deep hands-on experience with AWS and a strong opinion on what good cloud operations look like.

- Have experience managing Kubernetes clusters at scale, including upgrades, node group management, autoscaling, and cluster add-on lifecycle.

- Have experience with infrastructure-as-code tools like Pulumi or Terraform, and a strong preference for changes made through code, not consoles.

- Have experience navigating multi-region or multi-cloud environments on AWS or GCP.

- Stay curious and open to growth, demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.

It would be a bonus if you had even one of the following:

- Experience with Karpenter, cluster autoscaler, or other Kubernetes-native scaling tooling.

- Have experience with OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus or Grafana

- Experience building AI-assisted infrastructure tooling, including cost optimization loops, anomaly detection, or policy-as-code with LLM assistance.

- Experience contributing to multi-region architecture including data residency, regional failover, or latency-based routing.

You Are:

- Collaborative : You possess a collaborative spirit, thriving when working with both your immediate team and cross-functional partners.

- Strategic thinker : You're a strategic thinker, adept at defining clear business needs and evaluating solutions to make informed build-versus-buy decisions.

- Comfortable with ambiguity : You navigate ambiguous situations with ease, gathering data and making progress even with incomplete information or unclear requirements.

If you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying . Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.

Our Core Behaviors: 

- Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.

- Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.

- Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.

- Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.

Benefits 

- Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.

- Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.

- Support for every stage of family life . 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.

- Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.

- Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.

- Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally. 

- Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.

- Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.

Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment. 

Remote, together 

At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Webflow will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Stay connected 

Not ready to apply, but want to be part of the Webflow community? Consider following our story on our Webflow Blog , LinkedIn , X (Twitter) , and/or Glassdoor . 

Please note: 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Upon interview scheduling, instructions for confidential accommodation requests will be administered. 

To join Webflow, you'll need a valid right to work authorization depending on the country of employment. 

If you are extended an offer, that offer may be contingent upon your successful completion of a background check, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws. We may obtain one or more background screening reports about you, solely for employment purposes. 

For information about how Webflow processes your personal information, please review Webflow’s Applicant Privacy Notice .

title: Logistics Manager
description:
About Mistral 

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Our mission 

Build and scale the logistics capabilities that enable Mistral AI to deploy, operate and expand high-density compute infrastructure reliably. Own the flow, custody, traceability and readiness of high-value hardware, critical spares and associated materials - from supplier dispatch through site receipt, storage, deployment, repair and end-of-life disposition. Deliver speed without compromising safety, inventory integrity, security or cost control.

Operating context & accountability 

You will coordinate closely with Data Center Operations, IT Operations, deployment teams, Procurement, Finance, Security, Safety, colocation operators, carriers and OEM service partners. The role owns Mistral logistics processes and supplier performance.

Key responsibilities - deployment logistics and site readiness 

- Plan inbound and outbound movements for accelerator servers, racks, networking equipment, CDUs, replacement parts, tooling and deployment consumables across sites and staging locations.

- Translate deployment schedules and bill-of-materials requirements into shipment plans, delivery windows, site receiving capacity, material availability and clear responsibility assignments.

- Coordinate with business partners and site teams on loading bays, access approvals, delivery routes, floor loading, rack handling, lift plans, packaging removal, temporary storage and installation sequencing.

- Identify logistics dependencies that could delay energization, commissioning, rack acceptance or compute availability; maintain escalation paths, contingency plans and recovery actions.

- Create consistent procedures for goods receipt, inspection, damage recording, quarantine, staging, pick/pack, handover and proof of delivery, including exceptions and nonconformances.

- Manage reverse logistics for defective equipment, repair exchanges, warranty returns, redeployments and end-of-life assets, with documented chain of custody and secure disposition.

Key responsibilities - inventory, spares and asset traceability 

- Define and maintain an accurate inventory and asset-control framework for Mistral-owned equipment, including serialized items, location, ownership, status, movement history and reconciliation with IT asset records.

- Set and monitor critical spare-parts policies with IT Operations and OEM partners: minimum/maximum stock, lead times, failure demand, replenishment triggers, shelf-life and obsolescence exposure.

- Establish auditable stock movements, cycle counts, physical inventories, discrepancy investigations and controls for high-value or sensitive components.

- Monitor stock health, aging, availability, stranded inventory, shrinkage and repair turnaround; use evidence to optimize local versus regional stocking decisions.

- Coordinate secure storage conditions, ESD-sensitive handling, environmental requirements, battery transport/storage rules where applicable, and restricted access to valuable hardware.

- Develop common inventory taxonomy, operating procedures and system integrations to support growth across sites, providers and countries.

Key responsibilities - supplier, transport and commercial performance 

- Oversee third-party logistics providers, freight forwarders, warehouses, specialist rigging partners and couriers against agreed service levels, security controls and escalation requirements.

- Work with Procurement and Legal on supplier selection, scopes of work, insurance, liability, transport terms and measurable performance expectations.

- Coordinate cross-border shipping requirements with qualified customs and trade-compliance specialists, including import/export documentation, duties, restricted goods and relevant sanctions/export controls.

- Monitor freight, warehousing, handling, repair and expedite costs; challenge avoidable spend while protecting deployment dates and service restoration capability.

- Lead supplier performance reviews, delivery-failure investigations and corrective action follow-up; develop alternative routes and providers for critical supply chains.

- Maintain reliable forecasting and reporting of expected arrivals, shortages, inventory exposure, blocked shipments, deployment readiness and outstanding returns.

Key responsibilities - safety, resilience and cross-functional execution 

- Partner with Safety and site teams to assess high-risk material handling, rack moves, lifting/rigging, traffic management and contractor interfaces; verify that required plans and competent resources are in place.

- Coordinate physical-security requirements, access permissions, tamper evidence and chain of custody for sensitive or high-value technology.

- Develop practical business-continuity plans for shipment disruption, customs holds, supplier shortages, loss or damage in transit, and urgent hardware replacement needs.

- Work with IT Operations and OEM service partners to prioritize material flows during incidents and reduce mean time to restore affected compute capacity.

- Create clear operating rhythms and decision records across engineering, deployment, site teams and suppliers; escalate risks early and close actions with evidence.

Team Leadership & Organizational Development 

- Build, lead, and scale the team across regions, aligning organizational capabilities, staffing levels, and resources with Mistral AI’s growth trajectory and operational requirements.

- Supervise, coordinate, and support team members, ensuring clear accountability, effective collaboration, and consistent execution of responsibilities.

- Define the organizational structure, roles, responsibilities, and resource allocation required to support current operations and future expansion.
Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain high-performing professionals, ensuring the team possesses the technical expertise and capabilities required to meet business objectives.

- Establish clear performance expectations, measurable objectives, and development plans; conduct regular performance reviews and provide constructive feedback and coaching.

- Drive standardization of processes, procedures, and best practices across regions while accommodating local operational and regulatory requirements.

- Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and operational excellence.
Collaborate with cross-functional leaders to anticipate resource requirements, address organizational gaps, and ensure effective coordination across teams.

- Develop succession plans and strengthen internal capabilities to support organizational resilience and long-term scalability.

- Manage team priorities, workload distribution, and resource planning, ensuring effective execution while maintaining quality, safety, and operational efficiency.

What success looks like 

- Critical hardware and materials arrive complete, traceable, secure and ready for deployment when needed.

- Inventory accuracy is consistently high, with timely reconciliation and documented custody for valuable assets.

- Critical spare parts are available according to risk-based targets, reducing restoration delays and avoidable downtime.

- Logistics exceptions, shipment damage, deployment blockers and supplier failures are identified early and resolved with measurable corrective actions.

- Logistics processes scale across new sites without sacrificing safety, compliance, cost discipline or execution speed.

Minimum qualifications 

- At least 5 years of relevant experience in logistics, supply chain, warehouse operations, hardware deployment or inventory management in a complex technical environment.

- Hands-on experience coordinating high-value equipment shipments, third-party service providers, site receiving, stock controls and reverse logistics.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer 

Shiftbase is building the self-driving assistant for shift-based businesses across Europe. Our customers range from independent restaurants in Amsterdam to multi-location retailers in München, and they spend hours every week on scheduling, time tracking, payroll prep, and HR admin. We want to take that work off their plate and eventually do it for them. 

Underneath that product vision sits a data challenge. Insight, automation, and AI all depend on data people can trust, and the foundation for it doesn't exist yet. 

You will build the foundation that fixes this. 

What you'll do 

- Architect the warehouse. Design and own our BigQuery and Dataform warehouse from the ground up. Build a layered, well-modeled foundation, medallion staging through marts, not only the models that sit on top. Ask every day whether the whole company can trust and reuse it. 

- Make the data flow reliably. Build ELT and ETL with incremental, idempotent loads, orchestration, and retries, so pipelines run on time without anyone watching them. Ship monitored pipelines that hold up in production. 

- Take the transform layer. Own the Dataform model-building and transform layer, taking full responsibility for the transformation layer and freeing up capacity for semantic modeling and business definitions. This unblocks the whole team. 

- Build trust into the data. Make validation, freshness monitoring, alerting, and lineage the default. Diagnose failures at the root cause. leadscorev2 is the outcome this role exists to prevent. 

- Serve the whole company. Feed clean, governed datasets to Metabase, HubSpot, and the ML and AI work the product ML team owns. Push modeled data back into the tools business teams act on, including HubSpot and Customer.io . 

- Own the Platform handshake. Run the day-to-day collaboration with the Platform team on our GCP foundation, a bridge that only gets part-time attention today. 

- Treat the warehouse like a product. Keep documentation, lineage, and discoverability current so departments trust the data assets, and handle sensitive HR and workforce data to GDPR standards. 

What success looks like in your first 3–6 months 

- The warehouse has a real foundation. The first vertical slice, our accounts model, ships with tests and monitoring. 

- You fully own the Dataform transform layer, creating capacity for semantic modeling and business-definition work 

- Pipelines run against a defined freshness SLA, and you catch breaks before stakeholders do. 

- Documentation and lineage cover what you own, and datasets that were stuck now flow to the teams that need them. 

- 

What we're looking for 

You have built warehouse foundations yourself. You designed them rather than maintaining someone else's, with a track record in: 

- Designing layered warehouse architectures (medallion, bronze-silver-gold) and dimensional models (star and snowflake) that teams reuse 

- Advanced SQL as your daily working language 

- Hands-on BigQuery, since our stack is GCP 

- Building a SQL transform layer in Dataform, or strong dbt experience. 

- ELT and ETL with incremental, idempotent loads and real orchestration, scheduling, and dependency management 

- Data quality, testing, freshness monitoring, and lineage built in from the start 

- Python for pipeline code, scripting, automation, and API integration 

- Reviewable, repeatable change through Git and PR-based deployment 

Nice to have, not required: another modern cloud warehouse such as Snowflake or Redshift; managed ingestion such as Airbyte; preparing data for ML, LLM, and agentic use cases; and familiarity with B2B SaaS metrics and HR or workforce data. English is our working language, and Dutch is not required. 

This role isn't infrastructure engineering, ML or MLOps, or dashboard analysis. The Platform team owns infrastructure, the Product ML team owns ML, and the business teams own dashboards. It also isn't for someone who has only maintained a warehouse another person designed. You build the foundation properly, stay transparent about data quality and trade-offs, and treat the warehouse as a product for the whole company. You'll report to the Head of Operations and partner closely with the Platform team on the company's data architecture.

title: Agentic AI Principal
description:
We are looking for an Agentic AI Principal to act as a senior technical authority and trusted client advisor for complex agentic AI transformation in Germany, the Netherlands and the wider DACH region.

Operating at Principal level, you will shape enterprise AI strategy, define agentic architecture blueprints, lead high-value C-suite engagements and guide complex programmes from opportunity through delivery. You will bring deep hands-on credibility in multi-agent systems, governance and safeguards, while setting reusable patterns and raising capability across teams.

The role has particular focus on sovereign, compliant and production-grade agentic AI for regulated German, Dutch and European enterprises, with a primary focus on healthcare and life sciences (pharma, biotech, medtech and healthcare providers). Experience from other regulated sectors, such as financial services and insurance, automotive and manufacturing, energy and telecommunications, is equally welcome.

Our delivery model is moving from large time-and-materials teams to small, AI-first, multidisciplinary pods accountable to a business outcome. You will anchor the agentic side of that work, pairing with our data, tech advisory and industry domain leads from presale through delivery.

This is a client-facing, builder's leadership role. You will start with a small, senior team and grow it through technical depth, delivery excellence and thought leadership, rather than inheriting a large organisation.

Job responsibilities

Shaping and winning 

- Agentic AI advisory and strategy: shape and solution complex German, Dutch and DACH pursuits with account, commercial and delivery leaders, translating client needs into differentiated propositions, credible architectures and executable delivery approaches that support regional pipeline conversion.

- Independently drive complex pursuits with technical and executive stakeholders, including shaping the commercial model (fixed-price, outcome-linked), trade-offs and risk.

- Act as a sparring partner to C-suite buyers (CEO, CIO, CDO, CISO, COO): frame business-outcome hypotheses, challenge assumptions and define a thin slice of agentic delivery that proves value quickly.

- Lead AI maturity assessments, identify and prioritise processes for agentisation, and connect architecture choices to measurable business value and ROI.

- Represent Thoughtworks' agentic AI expertise in strategic client conversations, industry forums, partnerships and thought leadership where appropriate.

Designing and building 

- Design and build engineering: set the architecture direction for complex, production-grade agentic AI systems, including multi-agent workflows, orchestration, tool use, memory, context strategy, retrieval, evaluation, observability and enterprise integration.

- Integrate agents with the German enterprise core: SAP (S/4HANA, BTP), LIMS, QMS and clinical systems, MES/PLM and industrial systems, and legacy back-office platforms, using open protocols such as MCP and A2A where they fit.

- Ensure agents run on trustworthy data foundations, working with data engineering and data product teams on data quality, semantics and access.

- Design solutions for regulated German and EU environments, with strong consideration of data sovereignty (EU and German sovereign cloud, open-weight or self-hosted models where required), privacy, security, responsible AI and applicable regulation, including the EU AI Act and GDPR; for healthcare and life sciences GxP, EU MDR/IVDR and the European Health Data Space; and for other sectors DORA, NIS2 and BaFin requirements where relevant.

- Guide teams in balancing rapid experimentation with robust production engineering, including evaluation-driven development, testing, CI/CD, reliability, cost and performance optimisation.

- Provide technical and delivery leadership for complex programmes, staying hands-on enough to validate architecture, unblock teams, manage technical risk and ensure successful execution.

- Partner with product, data, software engineering, enterprise architecture, governance and change specialists to design end-to-end solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.

Governance and safeguards 

- Establish reusable patterns for observability, auditability, traceability and control of agentic systems, enabling teams to demonstrate safe and reliable behaviour in production.

- Translate EU AI Act obligations (risk classification, human oversight, logging, technical documentation, GPAI-provider responsibilities) into concrete engineering controls and evidence.

- Engage early with works councils (Betriebsrat, ondernemingsraad), data protection officers and information security, supporting DPIAs and co-determination processes so agentic solutions that touch employee workflows can go live.

- Anticipate technical, organisational and governance challenges in enterprise AI adoption and define practical approaches to address them.

Principal-level leadership and growing capability 

- Set reusable architecture patterns, engineering standards and governance practices across multiple teams and engagements, influencing the evolution of Thoughtworks' agentic AI capability beyond an individual programme.

- Set technical direction across multiple teams and initiatives, defining reusable patterns, frameworks and engineering standards for agentic AI delivery.

- Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, build the next generation of the German team, and raise AI fluency and agentic engineering standards across specialists and generalists.

- Evaluate emerging agentic AI technologies and frameworks and guide their responsible adoption based on client context, engineering quality and business value.

- Build our German and Dutch market presence through local-language points of view, ecosystem and partner initiatives (hyperscalers, SAP, European model providers) and community events.

Job qualifications

Technical Skills

- Deep expertise in modern software engineering and Python, with a strong track record of setting standards for testing, CI/CD, observability, maintainability and production reliability.

- Recognised experience architecting and delivering complex GenAI and agentic AI systems at enterprise scale, from early discovery through production deployment.

- Deep knowledge of agentic architectures and frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex or equivalent, including tool use, orchestration, memory, multi-agent coordination and interoperability protocols (MCP, A2A).

- Strong expertise in Retrieval-Augmented Generation, advanced information retrieval, vector databases and enterprise knowledge integration.

- Experience designing evaluation strategies for GenAI and agentic systems, including quality, safety, reliability, latency and cost measures.

- Strong understanding of AI governance and safeguards, including guardrails, red-teaming, observability, responsible AI and secure deployment practices (prompt injection, data leakage, tool misuse).

- Significant experience deploying AI systems on major cloud platforms using containers, orchestration and production-grade infrastructure patterns, including EU sovereign cloud, hybrid or on-premises setups and self-hosted open-weight models.

- Experience with model adaptation and optimisation techniques, including prompt/context engineering, fine-tuning where appropriate, and application-level performance optimisation.

- Ability to make sound architecture trade-offs across model capability, reliability, security, compliance, performance and cost.

- Working knowledge of the EU AI Act, GDPR and sector rules (for healthcare and life sciences: GxP and GAMP 5 computerised-system validation, EU MDR/IVDR, EHDS; for other sectors: DORA, NIS2, BaFin) and how they shape agentic system design.

- Strongly preferred: delivering AI in healthcare or life sciences (e.g. R&D, clinical, regulatory, manufacturing quality, commercial). 

- Nice to have: integrating agents with SAP and industrial or manufacturing systems; data product and data platform foundations for AI.

Consulting and Commercial Track Record

- Proven ability to lead C-suite and senior client engagements, rapidly establish credibility and advise on both business and technical choices.

- Strong consulting and commercial judgement: you can point to data and AI (ideally agentic or GenAI) pursuits you helped shape, sell and deliver in the last three to five years, from around €3M–5M upwards, including fixed-price or outcome-linked elements.

- Experience shaping, solutioning, selling and delivering complex deals of €5M+ in the last few years. Annual target of solutioning, selling and delivering €10M+ TCV in Data & AI deals with an AI-first delivery focus.

- Comfortable discussing P&L, business cases and ROI with executive buyers, not just architecture.

- Consultancy or professional-services experience within the last five years, ideally with German, Dutch or DACH enterprise clients.

- You have grown a practice, capability or go-to-market asset (e.g. a reusable accelerator).

Professional Skills

- Executive presence and communication skills, making complex agentic AI concepts, risks and trade-offs clear to technical and non-technical audiences.

- Proven leadership of complex delivery across multidisciplinary teams, moving fluidly between strategy, architecture, governance and hands-on technical leadership.

- Ability to influence across organisations without formal authority, align diverse stakeholders and navigate ambiguity in high-value or high-risk programmes.

- Proven ability to mentor senior engineers and technical leaders and raise standards across a wider engineering community.

- Self-directed, prioritisation-led working style, with creative problem-solving in fixed-scope, outcome-driven work.

- Experience navigating German and Dutch stakeholder structures, including works councils, data protection officers and procurement.

- German B2 minimum , C1 strongly preferred; fluent English. Dutch is a plus for Netherlands-based candidates.

Other things to know

Learning & Development

There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.

Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment

At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.

Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.

We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment .

About Thoughtworks

Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we’re pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let’s be extraordinary.

- Design solutions for regulated German and EU environments, with strong consideration of data sovereignty (EU and German sovereign cloud, open-weight or self-hosted models where required), privacy, security, responsible AI and applicable regulation, including the EU AI Act and GDPR; for healthcare and life sciences GxP, EU MDR/IVDR and the European Health Data Space; and for other sectors DORA, NIS2 and BaFin requirements where relevant.

- Guide teams in balancing rapid experimentation with robust production engineering, including evaluation-driven development, testing, CI/CD, reliability, cost and performance optimisation.

- Provide technical and delivery leadership for complex programmes, staying hands-on enough to validate architecture, unblock teams, manage technical risk and ensure successful execution.

- Partner with product, data, software engineering, enterprise architecture, governance and change specialists to design end-to-end solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.

Governance and safeguards 

- Establish reusable patterns for observability, auditability, traceability and control of agentic systems, enabling teams to demonstrate safe and reliable behaviour in production.

- Translate EU AI Act obligations (risk classification, human oversight, logging, technical documentation, GPAI-provider responsibilities) into concrete engineering controls and evidence.

- Engage early with works councils (Betriebsrat, ondernemingsraad), data protection officers and information security, supporting DPIAs and co-determination processes so agentic solutions that touch employee workflows can go live.

- Anticipate technical, organisational and governance challenges in enterprise AI adoption and define practical approaches to address them.

Principal-level leadership and growing capability 

- Set reusable architecture patterns, engineering standards and governance practices across multiple teams and engagements, influencing the evolution of Thoughtworks' agentic AI capability beyond an individual programme.

- Set technical direction across multiple teams and initiatives, defining reusable patterns, frameworks and engineering standards for agentic AI delivery.

- Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, build the next generation of the German team, and raise AI fluency and agentic engineering standards across specialists and generalists.

- Evaluate emerging agentic AI technologies and frameworks and guide their responsible adoption based on client context, engineering quality and business value.

- Build our German and Dutch market presence through local-language points of view, ecosystem and partner initiatives (hyperscalers, SAP, European model providers) and community events.

Job qualifications

Technical Skills

- Deep expertise in modern software engineering and Python, with a strong track record of setting standards for testing, CI/CD, observability, maintainability and production reliability.

- Recognised experience architecting and delivering complex GenAI and agentic AI systems at enterprise scale, from early discovery through production deployment.

- Deep knowledge of agentic architectures and frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex or equivalent, including tool use, orchestration, memory, multi-agent coordination and interoperability protocols (MCP, A2A).

- Strong expertise in Retrieval-Augmented Generation, advanced information retrieval, vector databases and enterprise knowledge integration.

- Experience designing evaluation strategies for GenAI and agentic systems, including quality, safety, reliability, latency and cost measures.

- Strong understanding of AI governance and safeguards, including guardrails, red-teaming, observability, responsible AI and secure deployment practices (prompt injection, data leakage, tool misuse).

- Significant experience deploying AI systems on major cloud platforms using containers, orchestration and production-grade infrastructure patterns, including EU sovereign cloud, hybrid or on-premises setups and self-hosted open-weight models.

- Experience with model adaptation and optimisation techniques, including prompt/context engineering, fine-tuning where appropriate, and application-level performance optimisation.

- Ability to make sound architecture trade-offs across model capability, reliability, security, compliance, performance and cost.

- Working knowledge of the EU AI Act, GDPR and sector rules (for healthcare and life sciences: GxP and GAMP 5 computerised-system validation, EU MDR/IVDR, EHDS; for other sectors: DORA, NIS2, BaFin) and how they shape agentic system design.

- Strongly preferred: delivering AI in healthcare or life sciences (e.g. R&D, clinical, regulatory, manufacturing quality, commercial).

- Nice to have: integrating agents with SAP and industrial or manufacturing systems; data product and data platform foundations for AI.

Consulting and Commercial Track Record

- Proven ability to lead C-suite and senior client engagements, rapidly establish credibility and advise on both business and technical choices.

- Strong consulting and commercial judgement: you can point to data and AI (ideally agentic or GenAI) pursuits you helped shape, sell and deliver in the last three to five years, from around €3M–5M upwards, including fixed-price or outcome-linked elements.

- Experience shaping, solutioning, selling and delivering complex deals of €5M+ in the last few years. Annual target of solutioning, selling and delivering €10M+ TCV in Data & AI deals with an AI-first delivery focus.

- Comfortable discussing P&L, business cases and ROI with executive buyers, not just architecture.

- Consultancy or professional-services experience within the last five years, ideally with German, Dutch or DACH enterprise clients.

- You have grown a practice, capability or go-to-market asset (e.g. a reusable accelerator).

Professional Skills

- Executive presence and communication skills, making complex agentic AI concepts, risks and trade-offs clear to technical and non-technical audiences.

- Proven leadership of complex delivery across multidisciplinary teams, moving fluidly between strategy, architecture, governance and hands-on technical leadership.

- Ability to influence across organisations without formal authority, align diverse stakeholders and navigate ambiguity in high-value or high-risk programmes.

- Proven ability to mentor senior engineers and technical leaders and raise standards across a wider engineering community.

- Self-directed, prioritisation-led working style, with creative problem-solving in fixed-scope, outcome-driven work.

- Experience navigating German stakeholder structures, including works councils, data protection officers and procurement.

- German B2 minimum , C1 strongly preferred; fluent English. 

Other things to know

Learning & Development

There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment

At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.

Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.

title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks (Contract)
description:

URL: https://www.askablelabs.com/ 

We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works 

- Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

- Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

- Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

- Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

- Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

- Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

- Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements 

- 2+ years of professional software engineering

- Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

- Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

- Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing

- Regular use of an AI coding tool

- Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models

- You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words

- At least 10 hours a week, starting now

- A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

Nice to have 

- Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

- Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

Terms 

- US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you

- Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

- The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us

- Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients. 

At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

This role can be filled in the Northeast (New York, NJ, Philadelphia, Boston), our San Francisco headquarters, OR other remote locations in the U.S. 

As a Commercial Data Scientist , you’ll work within cross-functional delivery teams alongside other analysts, engineers, and commercial stakeholders in discovering data insights to help improve healthcare.

How you’ll make an impact: 

- Deliver novel and impactful insights for client organizations using machine learning and AI technologies.

- Leverage Doximity's extensive datasets to identify and classify behavioral patterns of medical professionals on our platform.

- Respect – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals.

- Prior experience in a data science consulting role at firms such as ZS, Trinity, IQVIA, BlueMatter, etc., where you thrived in a fast-paced environment

- Hands-on experience with distributed data processing tools and concepts for scalable analysis and model training.

- Excellent data visualization and storytelling abilities, with the capacity to translate technical insights into clear, compelling narratives for internal and client stakeholders.

- Curious, fast learner with a demonstrated passion for data, continuous learning, and staying current with advances in machine learning research.

- Business decisions at Doximity are driven by our data, analyses, and insights.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

Machine Learning Engineer IV – (Computer Vision) 

We’re looking for a Staff/Senior Machine Learning Engineer with deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics to lead the design and scaling of face recognition systems in production. - Lead the design and development of computer vision systems for biometrics (face attributes, detection, quality, and recognition)
