- Production Engineering: Own the path to production. Optimize models for low-latency inference (quantization, distillation, TensorRT/ONNX) and manage deployment on AWS.

- Mentor ML engineers, conduct code/design reviews, and drive technical best practices across the Computer Vision team.

What We’re Looking For 

- Strong industry experience in Machine Learning, dedicated to Biometrics or Face Analysis.

- Deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics, especially face recognition.

- Fairness & Ethics: You understand the sources of algorithmic bias in Computer Vision and have practical experience measuring and mitigating disparate impact.

- Strong Engineering: Expert proficiency in Python (both machine learning and vision libraries such as Pillow, OpenCV, PyTorch, etc). You write clean, modular, production-ready code.

- Systems Architecture: Experience designing end-to-end ML pipelines (Data to Train to Deploy) and working with workflow orchestrators like Airflow.

- Cloud Native: Hands-on experience scaling training jobs on multi-GPU clusters and deploying services on AWS (SageMaker, EC2, EKS).

Nice to Have 

- Research Publications: Papers in CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, or FG related to face recognition, image quality assessment, or fairness.

- Large Scale Search: Experience with vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Faiss) and approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search algorithms.

- Familiarity with privacy, security, and compliance in biometric systems.

- Mobile/Edge Experience: Experience porting models to edge or mobile devices utilizing frameworks such as CoreML, LiteRT, and/or TFLite.

- Synthetic Data: Experience using GANs or diffusion models to generate synthetic faces for training.

- Strong communication skills.

Lead the design and development of computer vision systems for biometrics (face attributes, detection, quality, and recognition)

Strong Engineering: Expert proficiency in Python (both machine learning and vision libraries such as Pillow, OpenCV, PyTorch, etc). You write clean, modular, production-ready code.
Systems Architecture: Experience designing end-to-end ML pipelines (Data to Train to Deploy) and working with workflow orchestrators like Airflow.

title: Backend Software Engineer, SDK
description:
About LaunchDarkly Engineering 

LaunchDarkly helps engineering organizations ship software and AI with speed, safety, and control. Our platform gives teams the confidence to release gradually, target experiences to the right audiences, learn through experimentation, understand what is happening in production, and respond quickly when risk appears.

Our engineers build the systems, services, SDKs, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, and product experiences that make this possible. The work spans high-scale distributed systems, reliable data and event pipelines, intuitive enterprise workflows, and AI-powered capabilities that help teams manage the next generation of software delivery.

LaunchDarkly’s SDKs are used in systems that perform trillions of feature flag evaluations each day, giving our engineering work a direct connection to the reliability and customer experience of software around the world. As the company grows, we are expanding beyond traditional feature management into experimentation, observability, and AgentControl—helping customers control more of the software and AI lifecycle. That creates an unusually broad set of technical challenges, visible customer impact, and room for engineers to shape what comes next.

We believe in the power of teams. We work with humility, openness, curiosity, and care; we value clear communication, thoughtful technical judgment, inclusive collaboration, and a strong sense of ownership. We encourage people to apply even when they do not meet every qualification listed below. We are interested in the experience, perspective, and potential you would bring to the role.

About the Job 

As a Software Engineer on LaunchDarkly’s SDK team, you will build the primary touchpoint that our customers interact with on a daily basis. You’ll work with multiple technologies across our 35+ SDKs while enabling customers of all kinds to feature flag their code. When working on our SDKs, you’d be contributing to much more than thin client wrappers. Our SDKs are feature-rich agents with strong emphases on performance, concurrency, and resiliency -- all while following idiomatic practices for their tech stack.

LaunchDarkly serves trillions of feature flags daily to customers all around the globe, and every flag is handled by our SDKs. This team has a major impact not only on our company, but on our customers (and their customers). We are growing fast and we need your help writing the next chapter in our story.

Responsibilities: 

- 
Contribute to development for SDKs in supported platforms :

- 
Implement new features and improvements to meet customer performance and resiliency requirements

- 
Keep up to date with the latest development practices

- 
Collaborate with our engineering and product teams to drive the implementation and release of major features

- 
Actively maintain our open-source repositories

- 
Identify areas of improvement and advocate for best practices

- 
Have an active voice in shaping both technology and product decisions

Basic Qualifications:

- 
Demonstrable experience building libraries and packages used by other developers

- 
Polyglot background with an ability to context switch between languages quickly

- 
5+ years experience with at least two of the following: .NET/Go/Ruby/Python/NodeJS/Java

- 
Experience with the following is a plus:

- 
C++/Erlang/Haskell/Lua

- 
AI SDKs

- 
Observability SDKs

- 
Mobile development

- 
Strong computer science fundamentals

- 
Committed to working in a communicative, collaborative environment

- 
Self‐starter and problem solver, willing to solve difficult problems and work independently when necessary

- 
Strong testing background: experience building unit, integration, load tests, and benchmarks

- 
Experience writing production-ready code with emphasis on quality and maintainability

- 
Experience contributing to open-source software

Logistics:

- 
This is a remote role, with opportunities to visit the office in the Bay Area, California, for team offsites

- 
The SDK team is spread between Eastern and Pacific time zones

Highlights:

- 
You will work collaboratively with a team of highly experienced engineers who are amazing at the craft of engineering and building SDKs

- 
Your contributions will be publicly visible as the SDK team develops LaunchDarkly’s open-source SDKs in public

- 
LaunchDarkly uses our own SDKs. You will have opportunities working with the other teams within LaunchDarkly

- 
In this role, you can learn about many programming languages and frameworks

- 
You will have opportunities to strongly influence roadmap and prioritization

Pay: 

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 3: 

- Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $171,200 - $235,400**

- Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $154,100 - $211,860 **

- Zone 3: All other US locations - $145,500 - $200,090 **

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. 

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas. 
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary. 

About LaunchDarkly: 

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations. 

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

- Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages

- Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts

- Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize

- Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types

title: Generative Media Engineer, AI Social - CANADA
description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

The Opportunity 

AI Social is one of the most ambitious products we've ever shipped. An AI agent that produces on-brand Instagram carousels and reels for every Luxury Presence customer, from raw input data to finished media. It isn't LLMs writing code. It's LLMs designing, choosing the photo, voicing the script, picking the cuts, and composing the final frame.

As the Generative Media Engineer on AI Social , you own the render pipeline, the prompts and agent loops that drive it, and the visual quality of what ships. Product and content strategy partners set the direction; engineering and design peers ship alongside you. This is an unusual role at the intersection of code, design, AI, and social media. You don't fit the normal engineering mold, that's the point.

Skills and experience 

- Solid working knowledge of TypeScript and Node.js. You're comfortable shipping production code and you're ready to grow into our stack.

- Hands-on experience with LLM-driven systems. Prompts, structured outputs, tool-calling, agent loops, evals.

- At least one shipped piece of generative media in image, video, voice, or music that someone other than you has seen and used.

- A portfolio or body of work that demonstrates both technical depth and design sensibility.

- Bonus: a personal creator practice somewhere. A feed, a portfolio, a side project, a YouTube channel, an Are.na . Public, ongoing, under your own name. You understand the medium because you've lived in it.

- Formal or self-taught grounding in design, visual art, film, or motion.

- Comfort moving between exploratory PoC work and shipped-to-customers polish, with judgment about which mode is appropriate when.

Technical fluency with AI tools 

- You're already using Claude Code, Cursor, or similar AI-assisted development tools in your daily workflow. We're a Claude Code shop and we expect you to be fluent.

- Familiarity with MCPs and how tools like Figma, Notion, and Linear connect into AI-assisted workflows. You understand how these tools and integrations fit together and can help the team get more out of them.

- Beyond fluency, you're a dabbler and experimenter. You try new prompts, push their limits, and share what you learn. You have opinions about where the medium is headed.

Mindset 

- You're a tinkerer. You don't just build what's asked; you spot leverage points and build what's needed.

- You care about systems more than features. You'd rather build a template family that ships ten posts well than ten bespoke posts that age out by next week.

- You build on shared systems. Constraints feel like leverage, not obstacles.

- You have strong convictions about quality, but you ship. You know the difference between polish that matters and perfection that stalls.

- You partner well with non-engineers. You'll collaborate across product, design, and content strategy. Patience and clarity with people outside engineering is non-negotiable.

- You operate with high ownership and low ego. You take direction from product and strategy partners on what to build, and you raise the bar on everything you ship.

What You Won't Be Doing 

To be clear about what this role is not:

- You won't own platform architecture or distributed systems work. You'll partner with engineering teams that do, while you stay focused on the AI Social pipeline itself.

- You won't own the social strategy. You'll have a real voice in shaping it, but the call sits with our product and content strategy partners.

- You won't be managing people on day one. This is a hands-on IC role with the expectation that you lead through craft and influence.

Tech stack 

- Platform: Node, TypeScript, React, Postgres, AWS, Temporal

- LLMs and agents: the major model SDKs, with tool-calling, structured outputs, and multi-step agent loops

- Media pipeline: image and video generation (Veo for video), voice and music synthesis (ElevenLabs), composite (Shotstack), and headless browser rendering

Compensation

Additional Information

Join us in shaping the future of real estate 

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.

We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.

Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.

More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.

Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform.

Luxury Presence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
About Pleo 

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll take technical ownership of complex business domains, designing, building, and evolving scalable, reliable backend services for our enterprise spend management platform.

What you'll be working on: 

- Designing and operating distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native services.

- Applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to model complex business domains and define clear service boundaries.

- Building maintainable systems following Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, and similar architectural principles.

- Designing APIs, service integrations, and reliable asynchronous workflows using technologies such as Temporal.

- Designing secure authentication and authorization solutions, applying standards such as OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and WebAuthn, as well as fine-grained authorization models.

- Ensuring scalability, security, observability, and resilience in production.

- Continuously improving shared libraries, project structure, development tooling, and automated quality assurance practices to promote consistency, reusability, and maintainability across services.

- Driving architectural decisions, evaluating trade-offs, and mentoring other engineers.

- Leveraging AI extensively but responsibly, including developing guardrails, agent harnesses, and tooling to maintain engineering quality in a fast-paced environment.

We primarily use Node.js with TypeScript , but strong engineering fundamentals matter more to us than experience with a particular language. Our technology stack also includes Temporal, SpiceDB, PostgreSQL, Kafka, and Redis.

This is a 80/20 hands-on technical leadership role , combining deep engineering work with architectural ownership and influence across teams.
Remote, but travel to Amsterdam or other offsite meetings in Europe might occasionally be requested

Your colleagues would say you

- Lead by example and raise the bar with pragmatism and care.

- Communicate clearly, listen well, and bring people along in decisions.

- Enjoy breaking down complex problems, gathering input, and driving to a solution.

- Coach others and create space for people to grow.

- Prefer progress over perfection, while still caring deeply about quality.

Show me the benefits

- Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- Lunch is on us - with catering in our Lisbon, Copenhagen and London offices or a monthly lunch allowance paid directly together with your salary in other markets 

- Private health insurance to ensure you’re fit in body and mind to do your best work

- Wellbeing days - fully paid days off designed for a slower pace, allowing you to take time to recharge and prioritise self-care

- We provide access to MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and wellbeing support with great success so far 

- Access to LinkedIn Learning - acquire new skills, stay abreast of industry trends and fuel your personal and professional development continuously

- Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work 

About your application 

- English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

- A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

- Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

- Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

- Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here .

- Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

- Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Software Engineer AI Coding Tasks
description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works 

- Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
- Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
- Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
- Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
- Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
- Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
- Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements 

- 2+ years of professional software engineering
- Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
- Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
- Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
- Regular use of an AI coding tool
- Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
- You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
- At least 10 hours a week, starting now
- A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

Nice to have 

- Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
- Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

Terms 

- US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
- Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
- The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
- Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

About Creative Fabrica 

Creative Fabrica is a fast-growing AI platform that makes it easy for everyday consumers to create whatever they imagine, from images and videos to audio and 3D creations, using the latest generative AI models.

About the team: idea.ai 

idea.ai is our bet on what creative software looks like when AI is the default, not a feature.

We built a single platform where anyone can generate and edit images, video, audio, 3D models, and vector graphics using state-of-the-art generative AI. Our tools serve hundreds of thousands of creators every day, from hobbyist crafters to professional designers and everything in between, all in one place.

We move fast, integrate frontier models into production-ready workflows, and build the infrastructure that gives creators every tool they need to turn any idea into professional-grade media, at scale.

- Advanced Go Engineering: Extensive experience building and scaling Go services in high-traffic, high-volume SaaS environments.

- Distributed Systems Mastery: Proven ability to design microservices that utilize asynchronous processing (Kafka & SQS) and low-latency communication (gRPC/ConnectRPC/GraphQL).

- Cloud Architecture: Deep knowledge of AWS (EKS, S3, Lambda) and experience managing complex compute environments.

- Product Rigor: A background in building professional-grade creative tools or media-heavy applications.

title: ML Platform Engineer
description:
About us 

Bleu Robotics is an AI company developing universal AI software for the deployment of advanced robots , humanoids, mobile manipulators, and industrial arms, in real factories. The convergence of humanoid robotics and modern AI is one of the most significant technical opportunities of the decade, and most of the work today still happens in research settings. We are building the software layer required to bring it into operational use.

We have a strong ambition to become the next Microsoft to run on every industrial humanoid. We have closed our pre-seed round with Top-tier fund to deploy our robot in Tier 1 manufacturing facilities.

We are looking for deeply passionate scientists who can help us push the frontier and build a major lab in physical AI.

Our vision 

To enable a robot to learn a new industrial task from a few demonstrations and operate autonomously, with under one hour between the start of the demonstration and the start of deployment. 

This objective shapes our roadmap and every technical decision we make.

THE ROLE 

We are hiring an ML Platform Engineer to put our robot learning stack in the cloud and own the full stack. The platform will let customers run our learning pipelines on their own data as a hosted service; its exact scope will evolve with the product.

You will be the first engineer at Bleu Robotics with cloud expertise. The scope covers infrastructure, training and inference services, the web front end, security, and cost. The choice of cloud provider and web framework is open; you will make it with the team.

The role is based in Paris and is on-site. 

BACKGROUND 

We are equally interested in two kinds of background:

- software or ML platform engineer who has built and operated a cloud service that runs training or inference jobs on data uploaded by users (e.g., an ML platform team, an MLOps product, a SaaS that runs compute on customer data).

- backend or full-stack engineer with solid DevOps experience who has shipped a web product on a major cloud provider and wants to work on robot learning.

Experience with robotics or robot learning is appreciated but not required. You will learn the learning stack from the team; the team will learn cloud practices from you.

RESPONSIBILITIES 

- Design the architecture of the platform and select the cloud provider, orchestration layer, and web stack, in agreement with the team

- Package our training and inference pipelines (Python, PyTorch) as cloud services: job scheduling, GPU provisioning, artifact storage, versioning of datasets and policies

- Build the web application through which users upload data, follow training runs, and download policies, including its front end and API

- Add interactive, browser-based components to the platform, including simulation, as the product evolves

- Set up infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring, logging, and alerting for the platform

- Implement authentication, per-customer isolation, and data protection for confidential industrial data

- Control cloud costs: GPU usage, storage, and idle resources

- Bring cloud and DevOps practices to the rest of the engineering team through documentation, reviews, and training

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

- Master’s degree or PhD in computer science or a related field, followed by 2 to 3 years of professional experience building and operating a comparable cloud service

- Hands-on experience running production workloads on at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure, or a European provider such as Scaleway or OVHcloud)

- Proficiency with containers and orchestration (Docker and Kubernetes or a managed equivalent) and with infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar)

- Strong Python development skills for backend services, including asynchronous job execution

- Front-end development experience with a modern web framework (React, Vue, Svelte, or similar), sufficient to ship the user-facing application yourself

- Experience with CI/CD, monitoring, and security practices for a multi-tenant service

- Comfortable working in Linux environments with Git

- Professional proficiency in English, the official language of the team. Proficiency in French is not required; many of our employees do not speak French.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

The strongest candidates will combine cloud fluency with experience across several of the following:

- ML infrastructure: training job orchestration, GPU scheduling, experiment tracking, model registries

- PyTorch and the Python machine learning ecosystem

- Physics simulation (MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, or similar) and 3D rendering in the browser (WebGL, three.js)

- Streaming interactive content to the browser (WebRTC or similar)

- Data engineering for large volumes of video and time-series data

- Security and compliance requirements of industrial customers: data residency, access control, audit logs

- Cost optimization of GPU workloads

- An early-stage startup, or a leading research lab (academic or industrial)

THE TEAM 

The engineering team is a dozen top engineers and researchers in robotics and machine learning, organized around three focus areas: Integration, Vision & Perception, and Robot Learning. This position is the first cloud and platform role at Bleu Robotics. You will work with the whole team and with the founders on product decisions. Early hires help shape engineering practices, hiring, and culture.

What we offer 

- A clear, ambitious research mission with measurable real-world impact

- A diverse fleet of advanced robots, including humanoids, on which to run your research

- Research that ships: your algorithms run on real machines in real factories

- Tight collaboration with engineering teams that take your work to production

- Significant ownership of the research agenda as an early member of the team

- A focused, technically strong team and a serious engineering culture

- English-speaking working environment, no French required

- Fair compensation + equity

Backend Engineer 

About LaunchDarkly Engineering 

LaunchDarkly helps engineering organizations ship software and AI with speed, safety, and control. Our platform gives teams the confidence to release gradually, target experiences to the right audiences, learn through experimentation, understand what is happening in production, and respond quickly when risk appears.

Our engineers build the systems, services, SDKs, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, and product experiences that make this possible. The work spans high-scale distributed systems, reliable data and event pipelines, intuitive enterprise workflows, and AI-powered capabilities that help teams manage the next generation of software delivery.

LaunchDarkly’s SDKs are used in systems that perform trillions of feature flag evaluations each day, giving our engineering work a direct connection to the reliability and customer experience of software around the world. As the company grows, we are expanding beyond traditional feature management into experimentation, observability, and AgentControl—helping customers control more of the software and AI lifecycle. That creates an unusually broad set of technical challenges, visible customer impact, and room for engineers to shape what comes next.

We believe in the power of teams. We work with humility, openness, curiosity, and care; we value clear communication, thoughtful technical judgment, inclusive collaboration, and a strong sense of ownership. We encourage people to apply even when they do not meet every qualification listed below. We are interested in the experience, perspective, and potential you would bring to the role.

About the role 

We have multiple backend engineering roles open on various teams. The specific level, scope, and technical focus will be aligned to the opportunity and the candidate’s experience. Experience with cloud platforms, distributed systems, developer tools, SDK engineering, data infrastructure, observability, or AI/agent systems may be relevant for some teams.

As a Backend Engineer at LaunchDarkly, you will design, build, and operate the services that power reliable software delivery for our customers. You may work on APIs, distributed systems, configuration and event pipelines, data services, SDK-related infrastructure, platform capabilities, or backend systems supporting our product experiences.

You will work with experienced engineers, Product, Design, and partner teams to turn customer and business needs into simple, scalable solutions. You will have the opportunity to own work from early design through production, learn from real customer impact, and contribute to systems that operate at meaningful scale.

What you’ll do 

- Design, implement, test, and operate production services and APIs.

- Lead projects or meaningful components of projects from problem definition through deployment and iteration.

- Make thoughtful tradeoffs across scalability, performance, reliability, security, maintainability, and delivery speed.

- Improve the observability and operability of the systems you own, including metrics, logs, traces, alerting, and incident learnings.

- Collaborate with Product, Design, Support, Customer Success, and other engineering teams to understand needs and deliver useful outcomes.

- Participate in technical design discussions and code reviews, sharing constructive feedback and learning from teammates.

- Investigate production issues calmly and help turn operational lessons into lasting improvements.

- Contribute to a culture of inclusive collaboration, continuous improvement, and high-quality engineering.

Qualifications 

- 5+ years of experience building and operating production software in a professional environment, or equivalent demonstrable experience.

- Strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, testing, debugging, and API design.

- Experience with a backend language such as Go, Python, Rust, or an equivalent language. (Most of our teams use Go) 

- Experience designing or contributing to services that need to be reliable, observable, and maintainable as usage grows.

- Ability to explain technical decisions and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical partners.

- A collaborative approach and a sense of ownership for both your work and its downstream customer impact.

- Comfort learning unfamiliar systems and working through ambiguous problems.

Pay: 

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 3: 

- Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $171,200 - $235,400**

- Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $154,100 - $211,860 **

- Zone 3: All other US locations - $ 145,500 - $200,090 **

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. 

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas. 
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary. 

About LaunchDarkly: 

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations. 

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

- Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages

- Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts

- Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize

- Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types

- Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. title: Junior Supply Chain Engineer - Operations (H/F)
description:
Chez Withings, nous souhaitons redonner aux individus le contrôle de leur santé.

Nous avons l’obsession de créer des produits beaux et intuitifs, afin que chacun puisse les utiliser facilement au quotidien; nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd’hui utilisés par des millions d’utilisateurs.

Notre objectif : permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l’accompagnement d’un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants, afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de notre santé . 

Au sein de l'équipe Supply Chain basée à Issy-les-Moulineaux, nous recherchons un·e Junior Supply Chain Engineer – Opérations en CDI. Vous serez le point de contact de nos entrepôts en France et aux États-Unis, et le référent des opérations physiques : rework, reconditionnement, opérations à valeur ajoutée et retours B2B et B2C. En collaboration avec les équipes ADV, Planning, Qualité et Service Client, ainsi qu'avec nos collègues aux États-Unis et en Chine, vous veillerez à la fiabilisation de ces flux, à l'évaluation de leur performance et de leurs coûts.

Vos missions principales : 

1. Entrepôts et stocks 

- Être le point de contact de nos entrepôts en France, aux États-Unis et en Asie, et veiller au respect des process.
- Garantir la fiabilité des stocks : inventaires tournants et trimestriels, réconciliation 3PL / ERP, traitement du stock dormant.
- Mettre en place les opérations à valeur ajoutée : rework, kitting, personnalisation.
2. Retours et reconditionnement 

- Gérer les retours B2B et B2C, et harmoniser les process entre l'Europe, les États-Unis et l'Asie.
- Piloter la chaîne de refurb (diagnostic, tests qualité, remise en stock) et le suivi des pièces détachées.
3. Performance et coûts 

- Suivre les KPIs opérationnels (stocks, délais, retours, transporteurs) et produire le reporting mensuel.
- Analyser les coûts logistiques, contrôler la facturation des prestataires et identifier des leviers d'économie.
4. Automatisation et process 

- Automatiser les flux de données avec nos prestataires (Python, API, Shopify Flow) et maintenir les tableaux de bord de l'équipe.
- Rédiger et tenir à jour les procédures opérationnelles (SOP).
Requirements 

- Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bac +5 spécialisé dans la Supply ou issu d’une école d’ingénieur ou équivalent.
- Une première expérience (stage, alternance ou 0 à 2 ans) en logistique, entreposage ou opérations.
- Vous maîtrisez Excel, savez travailler avec SQL et analyser des bases de données ; des connaissances en Python sont un vrai atout.
- Vous connaissez le fonctionnement d'un ERP et d'un WMS, et vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils informatiques (Pack Office, Google Suite, IA).
- Anglais professionnel courant : vous travaillerez au quotidien avec des prestataires et des collègues en Europe, aux États-Unis et en Asie.
- Rigueur, proactivité, autonomie, sens de l'organisation et adaptabilité : vous êtes force de proposition et d'amélioration.
- Vous avez une aisance relationnelle pour faire avancer des sujets avec des partenaires externes et des équipes internes variées.
Benefits 

- Rejoindre l’aventure Withings, c’est :

- Intégrer un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronic Show
- Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux pour la santé de demain dans un environnement agile et en constante évolution
- Intégrer une entreprise internationale, membre de la FrenchTech 120, dont les équipes sont basées à Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong-Kong et Shenzhen 
- Participer à l’amélioration continue de nos produits et services en les bêta-testant avant leur sortie, notamment lors de nos nombreuses sessions sportives entre collègues
- Bénéficier de nombreux avantages : Stock Options, smartphone et ordinateur de votre choix, réductions pour des activités culturelles et sportives, restaurant d’entreprise, et bien plus encore
- Participer à la Withings Med Academy en assistant à des conférences de professionnels de santé afin de renforcer ses connaissances dans le domaine médical
- Collaborer avec des collègues passionnés et célébrer ensemble chacune de nos réussites !

Toutes les candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’origine ethnique, des opinions, des croyances, de la religion, du genre, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de la santé des candidats. Withings aspire à offrir et garantir l’égalité des chances aux candidats et seules les personnes habilitées (RH et Management) auront accès aux informations concernant votre candidature.

title: Senior ML Engineer
description:
Working at CreateFuture 

CreateFuture is an AI-native consulting partner where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference while always putting people first.

We’re a team of creators. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people. We work side by side with our clients, challenging what’s not working and helping them to build the future. Our commitment to craft, quality, and culture has helped us scale to over 600 people in just a few years.

CreateFuture is a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company and has won Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row.

Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today.

About the role and team: 

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with a machine learning focus to join our data team, taking ownership of the data and feature pipelines that production ML systems depend on, training data preparation, feature engineering, and the path from a model that works in a notebook to one that runs, and keeps running, in production. You’ll work with a high degree of autonomy on the more complex and ambiguous problems across client engagements, partnering closely with data scientists and ML engineers, while mentoring junior engineers and helping to raise the bar on engineering practice. The foundations still matter: this is a data engineering role at heart, built on Python, PySpark, and platforms like Databricks, Snowflake, or AWS.

What you'll be doing: 

- Take ownership of designing, building, and maintaining the production data and feature pipelines that machine learning systems depend on, training data preparation, feature engineering, and reproducible, point-in-time-correct datasets, with minimal supervision

- Take models from prototype to production and keep them there: packaging and deployment alongside data science colleagues, model versioning, automated retraining, and the monitoring that catches drift and degradation before a client does

- Build and maintain the batch and ELT pipelines the ML work sits on, using Python, PySpark, and cloud data services (e.g., AWS Glue, EMR, S3, Redshift, Athena, or the Databricks / Snowflake equivalents), making sound decisions on architecture, data modelling, and tooling and weighing up trade-offs in performance, cost, and maintainability

- Own and continuously improve CI/CD for data and ML workflows, ensuring reliable, repeatable deployments of pipelines and models alike

- Mentor and support junior and mid-level data engineers, reviewing code and sharing knowledge to raise the standard of delivery across the team

- Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in live data pipelines and deployed models, acting as a point of escalation for the wider team

- Partner with data scientists, cross-functional teams, and client stakeholders to understand data and ML requirements and shape them into technical solutions

We'd love to talk to you if you: 

- Have hands-on experience building the data and feature pipelines behind production machine learning, training data preparation, feature engineering, and feature stores, and understand why reproducibility and point-in-time correctness matter more than they first appear

- Have worked with MLOps in practice rather than in principle: model versioning and registries, experiment tracking, automated retraining, and monitoring for drift and model degradation (MLflow, SageMaker, Databricks ML, Vertex AI or comparable)

- Are comfortable with ML frameworks such as scikit-learn, PySpark MLlib, or PyTorch / TensorFlow, enough to productionise a data scientist’s work, reason about what a model needs from the data, and spot where a training pipeline and a serving pipeline have quietly diverged. You don’t need to be the person designing the model

- Have designed and operated production data pipelines on a modern cloud data platform, AWS (Glue, EMR, Redshift, S3/Lake Formation), Databricks, Snowflake or comparable, and can talk about which of those decisions would travel to a different one, and which wouldn’t

- Have deep SQL skills and hands-on experience with data modelling (e.g., Kimball, medallion/lakehouse patterns, or domain-driven modelling), this is the load-bearing, provider-agnostic skill underneath almost all of our pipeline work

- Have strong Python and PySpark for batch processing, with production-grade, well-tested code. The bulk of this work is batch and ELT, but you’ll need to have experienced event-driven or micro-batch pipelines and know where the design assumptions stop holding

- Have owned orchestration in production, dependency design, retries, SLAs, and the observability that tells you a pipeline failed before the client does

- Have experience owning the delivery of data engineering work with limited oversight, including CI/CD management and support

- Have experience mentoring or supporting the development of less experienced engineers

- Are comfortable working directly with stakeholders to shape technical solutions from ambiguous requirements, presenting your work, estimation and discussing tradeoffs and risks.

What we’ll offer you: 

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Our hiring process 

We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.

It usually looks like this:

- Call with our Talent Acquisition Team 

- Role specific capability interview 

Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.

Inclusion at CreateFuture 

We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.

If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just. We will do what we can to help.

We look forward to your application!

title: (Senior) Integration Engineer, ERP (Oracle)
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 

About the role

BLP only works when it talks to our customers’ ERP systems. As an Integration Engineer, you build and own those connections and keep live integrations running for enterprise customers. Every new ERP system is a new problem to solve. You’ll lead our Oracle integrations across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards, while also contributing to other integrations.

What you’ll do

- Own our integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards and ensure their market fit, usability and reliability.

- Design and implement interfaces for diverse protocols: REST, SOAP, direct DB access and file transfers.

- Explore new ERP systems and determine the best way to connect them.

- Build new ERP integrations, often in close collaboration with pilot customers.

- Own existing integrations end to end, including issue resolution, and document them so teammates can pick them up.

- Enable technical project managers to consult on, install and configure mature integrations.

What you'll bring

- Hands-on integration experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, ideally more than one. You have built or maintained interfaces yourself, not only used the system as a functional consultant or key user.

- Experience with the native interfaces of at least one of these:

- Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP: REST and SOAP web services, File-Based Data Import (FBDI) through the ERP Integration Service, and data extraction with BI Publisher or BI Cloud Connector (BICC).

- NetSuite: SuiteTalk REST and SOAP web services, SuiteQL, SuiteScript 2.x (e.g., RESTlets, Map/Reduce scripts), and Token-Based Authentication or OAuth 2.0.

- JD Edwards EnterpriseOne: AIS Server and Orchestrator, Business Services (BSSV), and Z-file interface tables (e.g., F0411Z1) with their batch processors.

- A good understanding of purchase-to-pay data in Oracle ERPs: suppliers, purchase orders, receipts and supplier invoice matching.

- Solid programming skills in at least one backend language. We build our integrations in Go. If you come from Java, C#, Python or similar and are keen to pick up Go, that works for us.

- A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

- A structured, self-reliant way of working, and ideally experience in a client-facing role.

- Fluent English. German is a plus, as most of our customers are in the DACH region.

Nice to have: 

- Experience with both cloud (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite) and on-premise (JD Edwards) environments, and the constraints of each (e.g., no direct database access in Fusion, governance limits in NetSuite).

- Extensive experience with SQL, common data formats (JSON, XML, CSV) and transports (REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP).

- Familiarity with modern engineering practices: Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD.

- Integration experience with other ERPs, such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Infor.

Integration Engineer or Senior Integration Engineer

We hire at both levels. Four things decide where you start: years of experience, breadth of experience, coaching experience and scope.

Integration Engineer 

- Years: 2+ years of hands-on integration work, including Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.

- Breadth: in-depth experience with one Oracle ERP and its interfaces.

- Coaching: you learn quickly from senior colleagues and share what you learn with the team.

- Scope: you deliver and maintain integrations and resolve issues independently, with guidance on architecture decisions.

Senior Integration Engineer 

- Years: 5+ years of hands-on integration work, several of them with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.

- Breadth: integration experience across two or more of Fusion, NetSuite and JD Edwards, or across Oracle and other ERPs, in cloud and on-premise environments.

- Coaching: you have coached or mentored other engineers and help technical project managers grow.

- Scope: you own our Oracle integrations end to end, set technical direction and take on the most complex customer cases.

Why BLP 

- Real impact: your integrations decide whether a customer goes live.

- Breadth: Oracle, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and many other ERPs, plus EDI and e-invoicing standards.

- Growth: fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares.

- Team: regular team events.

Practical information

- Location: our Zurich office, hybrid with 3+ office days per week, or remotely from anywhere in Europe.

- If you work remotely, we pay for regular visits and stays in Zurich.

- Employment: full-time, permanent.

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers .

title: Senior Software Engineer, Processing
description:

Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.

Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.

We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. Position: Senior Software Engineer, Processing

Location: Remote

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer for our Processing team to lead Lithic’s next phase of growth.

The Processing team builds and maintains the real-time interfaces between Lithic and external payment networks. Every card authorization, clearing message, and settlement file flows through systems this team owns. The team manages both online and batch transaction flows across Mastercard, Visa, and Amex, along with transaction enrichment, disputes processing, and network compliance. The systems we maintain have strict latency and uptime requirements, because they sit on the critical path for every card transaction. The team also manages the physical network peering with card network partners, so infrastructure and networking expertise are important. The team primarily uses Java, Python, and Kotlin on AWS.

What you'll do: 

- Ensure high reliability, low latency, and correctness for Lithic's transaction processing interfaces and related services

- Develop new capabilities across authorization, clearing/settlement, disputes, and network integration surfaces

- Ensure that the team is delivering reliable, secure, and scalable code with minimal tech debt

- Evolve the infrastructure supporting physical network peering with card network partners, ensuring connectivity, failover, and capacity meet reliability requirements

- Own initiatives from planning to launch, keeping stakeholders informed and aligned along the way

- Participate in the team on-call rotation

- Lead efforts to improve systems and processes both within the team and across engineering

- Help drive strategic planning in collaboration with the engineering manager and product manager

What you'll bring: 

- 8+ years experience shipping code in fast paced production environments

- Advanced distributed system instincts and design skills

- Experience driving large cross-functional projects across engineering, product, and operations teams

- A proven commitment to empathy and inclusion

- Excellent communication skills

- Growth mindset and continuous desire to learn and improve is a must

- An interest in fintech and the payments space is preferred

The annual US salary range for this role is $160,000 - $200,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications. 

This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States, Canada (Ontario or British Columbia), Netherlands, Poland, or Czech Republic. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.

- You’ll help evolve engineering tools, platforms, and practices and encourage adoption of better ways of working. 

- You’ll look for practical ways to use AI tools to improve engineering productivity, analysis, documentation, and problem-solving. 

Who You Are

You’re a hands-on data engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and building systems that others depend on. You combine strong technical depth with a practical understanding of business needs and know how to turn ambiguous requirements into scalable solutions. 

You take ownership, communicate clearly, and are comfortable leading technical work without relying on formal authority. You enjoy mentoring others and helping teams make stronger technical decisions. 

What You Bring 

Skills & experience 

Required 

- 8+ years of experience in data engineering, with strong experience in data architecture, ETL, and database management. 

- Strong programming skills in Python or PySpark, plus experience with Java or Scala. 

- Experience building complex end-to-end data pipelines and data integration solutions. 

- Strong knowledge of SQL and experience with relational and NoSQL database technologies. 

- Experience with big data technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, or similar platforms.

- Experience working in Agile environments such as Scrum, Lean, or Kanban. 

- Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. 

- Experience mentoring junior engineers and contributing to technical leadership within a team. 

- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams. 

Nice to Have 

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.

- Databricks experience or certification.

- Experience with AWS Redshift, S3, Azure SQL Data Warehouse, or comparable cloud data services.

- Experience implementing data governance, data quality, or observability frameworks.

- Experience leading cross-functional or multi-month engineering initiatives.

- Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development, troubleshooting, documentation, or productivity.

Our AI Mindset 

We build with AI. We lead with judgment. 

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. 

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. 

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
emerchantpay is a leading global payment service provider and acquirer for online, mobile, in-store and over the phone payments. Our global payments solution is available through a simple integration, offering a diverse range of features, including global acquiring, global and local payment methods, advanced fraud management and performance optimisation. We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join our AI Engineering team and help design, build, and roll out production-grade AI solutions, with a strong focus on AI engineering, AI agents, agentic workflows, machine learning, GenAI, and LLM-based applications .

This is a senior individual contributor role within the AI Engineering team. The Senior AI Engineer will work closely with the AI Tech Lead , engineering teams, product stakeholders, data teams, cloud/platform teams, and security teams to deliver reliable AI capabilities into real business systems.

The technology stack is diverse and can include Python (FastAPI/Flask/Django) or equivalent frameworks; React on the frontend side, and various ML/AI frameworks, APIs, cloud-native services, along with modern AI tooling .

The role will have a strong focus on AWS , including Amazon Bedrock , Amazon Bedrock AgentCore , Amazon SageMaker , and other AWS AI/ML services.

Responsibilities 

- Design, build, and maintain AI-powered applications, services, and integrations as part of the AI Engineering team.
- Implement solutions focused on AI agents, agentic workflows, automation, LLM-based applications, and AI-assisted business processes .
- Build and integrate AI applications using technologies such as Python (FastAPI/Flask/Django) or equivalent frameworks, React frontends, and relevant AI/ML frameworks .
- Implement AI solutions using AWS AI/ML services , including Amazon Bedrock , Amazon Bedrock AgentCore , Amazon SageMaker , and other AWS services for model hosting, inference, orchestration, data processing, monitoring, and security.
- Work closely with the AI Tech Lead to align on architecture, technology choices, engineering standards, AI patterns, and rollout approaches.

- Implement AI evaluation approaches for LLM outputs, RAG quality, agent behavior, model performance, hallucination detection, safety, and reliability.

- Collaborate with product managers, engineers, data scientists, DevOps, security, and business stakeholders to deliver practical AI solutions.
- Write clean, maintainable, testable, and well-documented code.
- Support production rollouts, troubleshooting, monitoring, optimization, and continuous improvement of AI systems.
- Stay current with modern AI technologies, frameworks, models, and engineering practices, and bring practical recommendations to the team.
Requirements 

- Minimum 7-8 years of professional experience in software engineering, AI engineering, ML engineering, data science, or related technical roles.
- At least 2-3 years of experience in AI development, ML engineering, or data science , with a demonstrated track record of deploying machine learning models and AI solutions in production environments.
- Strong hands-on experience building production-grade AI, ML, and data-driven systems .
- Practical experience with AI agents, agentic workflows, LLM-based applications, tool-calling architectures, workflow automation, and AI orchestration patterns .

- Strong Python development experience, including experience with Python (FastAPI/Flask/Django) or equivalent frameworks .
- Some experience with React for building user-facing AI tools, internal applications, dashboards, or workflow interfaces.
- Strong knowledge of AWS , including practical experience with cloud-native architectures, Amazon Bedrock , Amazon Bedrock AgentCore , Amazon SageMaker , and related AWS AI/ML services (t he more, the better) 
- Experience with advanced LLM frameworks such as LangChain , LlamaIndex , Semantic Kernel , CrewAI , AutoGen , or similar agent/orchestration frameworks.
- Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow , and familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers .
- Hands-on experience using LLMs via APIs, such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini , or similar providers.
- Experience with ML pipelines and MLOps , including data preparation, model training, model deployment, experiment tracking, model/version management, monitoring, evaluation, and production support.
- Experience with AI evaluation frameworks, tools, and techniques for assessing LLM outputs, RAG performance, agent behavior, model quality, safety, reliability, and regression over time.
- Knowledge or practical experience with RLHF - human-in-the-loop evaluation, preference data, reward modeling, or feedback-driven model improvement.
- Experience with vector databases and retrieval/search technologies , such as Amazon OpenSearch , Pinecone , pgvector , or similar.
- Experience building RAG systems , including document ingestion, chunking strategies, embeddings, retrieval evaluation, reranking, and grounding techniques.
- Experience with model fine-tuning, embedding models, transformer architectures, open-source LLMs, and model benchmarking .
- Knowledge of API design , microservices, event-driven systems, and cloud-based architectures.
- Good understanding of security and governance requirements for AI systems, including access control, secrets management, data privacy, audit logging, and safe handling of sensitive data.
- Experience working in cross-functional teams with engineers, product managers, data scientists, DevOps, security, and business stakeholders.
- Strong problem-solving skills and ability to turn AI prototypes into reliable, maintainable production systems.
- Strong communication skills and ability to explain technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Considered as an Advantage

- Experience with containerization and orchestration, including Docker and EKS/ECS .
- Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform , AWS CDK , or CloudFormation .
- Experience with data platforms, ETL/ELT pipelines, data lakes, feature stores, and real-time data processing.
- Experience implementing responsible AI controls, AI governance frameworks, safety guardrails, and compliance processes.
- Experience with observability for AI systems, including tracing, cost monitoring, prompt/model analytics, latency tracking, and quality dashboards.
- Experience integrating AI systems with enterprise platforms, internal APIs, CRM/ERP systems, ticketing systems, knowledge bases, and workflow engines.

location: Nantes, Pays de la Loire, France
description:
La mission : 

A travers le stage, vous aurez l'opportunité de mettre en pratique vos compétences, d'apprendre auprès d'experts, et de contribuer à des projets concrets et impactants. 

Être consultant, c’est participer à des projets qui répondent à la fois à des enjeux techniques et à des problématiques orientées business qui concernent des secteurs d’activité variés (luxe, retail, banque/assurance, industrie, etc). 

Nos missions allient une dimension technique et opérationnelle permettant d’approfondir vos connaissances sur des sujets novateurs. Vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie de la donnée afin de développer et faire vivre les applications data stratégiques de nos clients. Lors de vos projets vous serez amené à travailler sur les éléments suivants : 

- Vous participerez au cadrage du besoin client et à la réflexion sur les méthodologies et architectures à mettre en œuvre pour y apporter des réponses grâce à la Data et à l'IA, 

- Vous identifierez, intégrerez et structurerez les données (sources, connecteurs ETL/ELT, modélisation) pour transformer la donnée brute en indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) exploitables et fiables, 

- Vous réaliserez des analyses approfondies et concevrez des modèles (statistiques, machine learning, algorithmes IA, agentiques) pour répondre à des problématiques complexes (comportement client, prédictif, optimisation), 

- Vous mettrez en valeur vos résultats et industrialiserez vos solutions , en créant des outils de restitution pour les équipes métiers et en appliquant les meilleures pratiques de programmation, 

- Vous ferez preuve d'une forte appétence pour l'écosystème IA , en restant en veille sur les innovations, en expérimentant de nouveaux usages et en développant des briques/solutions IA dès que le sujet s'y prête. 

En fonction de votre appétence et de vos envies, un sujet à dominante technique ou business vous sera confié. 

Ci-dessous des exemples de sujet : 

- Optimisation de la préparation de commande en magasin avec un algorithme d’optimisation sous contrainte, 

- Utilisation de la Gen AI pour extraire des informations depuis des documents PDF et générer des synonymes afin d’améliorer les recherches documentaires, 

- Mise en place d’un score de churn par rayon et par magasin avec utilisation de méthodes de Machine Learning Interprétable, 

- Implémentation d’une segmentation des visites basées sur les données de navigation du site e-commerce , 

- Identifier les magasins à caractère saisonnier en termes de chiffre d’affaires, afin d’ajuster les budgets hebdomadaires et d'optimiser le ciblage des campagnes marketing, 

- Développement d’un dashboard dédié au service du Contrôle de Gestion d’un grand groupe de prêt-à-porter afin d’analyser tous les mois le profil des clients ayant contribué au chiffre d’affaires, 

- Développement d'agents conversationnels (LLM) pour interroger les données de vente et mise en place de cas d'usage IA. 

Lab’ AVISIA : 

En complément de nos missions, nous menons divers projets internes qui alimentent notre recherche et développement . Ces projets nous donnent l'opportunité d'offrir à nos clients des approches analytiques innovantes, testées en grandeur nature. 

Afin de soutenir ces initiatives, nous avons mis en place nos propres infrastructures . Nos consultants bénéficient ainsi des ressources les plus récentes et des dernières solutions du marché pour leur apprentissage, y compris des versions "early adopter" à tester avant leur mise à disposition générale. 

Nos engagements : 

Après avoir mis en place une politique interne solide en termes de RSE, nous avons souhaité mettre nos compétences au service de projets orientés développement durable . Une initiative dédiée est née : AVISIA Impact . 

Cette initiative est ainsi notre réponse pour apporter une contribution directe (via nos projets) et indirecte (via la formation de nos équipes) aux enjeux de transformation durable. Nous voulons ainsi faciliter l’émergence des futurs acteurs de la transformation et accélérer le rythme du changement. 

Pour plus d'information sur ces initiatives data au service de la transformation durable, n'hésitez pas à consulter notre page dédiée Data For Impact .

Nous recherchons donc des talents ayant : 

- Ayant un excellent relationnel, 

- Avec la volonté de s'impliquer sur la réussite de projet client, 

- Dotés d’un bon esprit d’analyse et de synthèse, 

- Qui accordent une importance particulière à la qualité des livrables ainsi qu’à la présentation, 

- Curieux et soucieux de se tenir informé des évolutions du marché, 

- Avec l’envie de continuer à apprendre pour être acteur de leur progression. 

Les compétences : 

Vous êtes en dernière année de formation data à l’université ou en grande école et disposez des compétences suivantes : 

- Très bonne connaissance du SQL et Python, 

- Bonne connaissance des principaux algorithmes de machine learning, 

- Capacité à expliquer des concepts complexes de façon simple et pédagogique, 

- Bonne connaissance des outils d'IA générative (Gemini, chatGPT…) et de développement assisté (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code...) pour optimiser son efficacité au quotidien,

title: Staff Software Engineer - Market Data
description:
About Dune 

Dune's mission is to make onchain finance observable. We're the industry standard for onchain data: a blockchain data and intelligence provider that institutions, protocols, and analysts trust to understand the onchain world and the frontiers of finance. We deliver structured datasets, spanning stablecoins, RWAs, tokens, lending, trading, and more, from 130+ chains and counting, to 1,000+ industry leaders including Visa, WisdomTree, FINRA, the IMF, Bloomberg, Standard Chartered, Coinbase, Forbes, and the Financial Times.

We're a tight knit team of ~50 hard working people, spread across Europe and eastern US timezones ️, having an outsized impact on the industry. We take pride in being ambitious and doing world class work while staying humble and lighthearted. We believe in building open, verifiable data that lets individuals and institutions do deep research into ecosystems like Ethereum, Solana, Robinhood and many more.

We're backed by some of the world's best investors. In February 2022, we announced our Series B funding round led by Coatue and Union Square Ventures, an important milestone that let us double down on our mission.

If you like being challenged and want to work together with a brilliant team on an important mission, come join us.

Learn more about us: 

About Dune
https://dune.com/about 

Values and working at Dune

https://dune.com/careers 

About the role 

Dune is building market data solutions for institutional customers who need timely, accurate and reliable financial data they can depend on. Our team turns onchain activity into realtime feeds and associated reference data along with historical data capture.

You will work on our new market data platform, and help shape how it evolves to support the growing features and customer base. You’ll design systems that can grow across chains, protocols and product capabilities while making clear decisions about correctness, latency, reliability, and cost.

This is a hands-on Staff Engineer role. You will be expected to turn ambiguous requirements into designs and deliverable work, implement difficult parts yourself, and help other engineers own meaningful parts of the platform. AI-assisted development is a core part of how we expect you to work, paired with strong engineering judgment and ownership of what you ship.

In this role you will 

- 
Design and build distributed systems for ingestion, normalization, processing, storage, and delivery of realtime market data from blockchain and other relevant sources.

- 
Build and operate streaming solutions that handle event ordering, timestamps, duplicates, replay, gaps, and recovery, including blockchain reorganizations and finality where they affect customer data.

- 
Build reliable client feeds and APIs with clear delivery contracts, schema evolution, access controls, and predictable behavior under load or when consumers fall behind.

- 
Partner with teams across Dune on reference data models and historical data capture.

- 
Define and improve service objectives and data quality measures.

- 
Instrument latency, freshness, completeness, and correctness, and turn incidents into lasting improvements in recovery and operations.

- 
You will debug independently and drive root cause analysis to a fix that holds.

- 
Own services through deployment and production support, including participation in the team’s on-call rotation.

- 
Use AI throughout development: explore designs, implement changes, build tests, investigate failures, and improve documentation. Develop repeatable workflows and share what works with the team.

- 
Lead technical decisions across team boundaries, write clear designs, and mentor engineers through implementation and review.

You might be a great fit if 

- 
You have built and operated distributed backend or data services with demanding reliability and performance requirements. You understand their failure modes and can debug problems across service and data boundaries.

- 
You have experience with realtime streaming systems, including concurrency, state management, backpressure, and recovery. You care about data correctness, from timestamps and numeric precision to schema changes and corrections.

- 
You have strong computer science fundamentals and backend engineering skills. Experience in Rust, Go or comparable languages is also valuable.

- 
You turn ambiguous requirements into pragmatic designs and production services, and help other engineers deliver parts of the solution.

- 
You communicate clearly in writing and work effectively with a distributed team.

- 
Financial or market data experience at a financial institution.

Not required but a plus 

- 
Onchain data experience: blockchain indexing such as with EVM or Solana.

- 
Reference data experience: instrument and entity masters, identifier mapping, effective-dated records, or tokenized asset and fund data.

- 
Experience at a company where the data is the product.

Perks & Benefits 

- 
A competitive salary and equity package . Both salary and equity is top 25% of companies in the space

- 
Our employee equity scheme has world-class employee-friendly terms with a heavily discounted strike price (~90%) and a 10-year exercise window

- 
5 weeks PTO + local public holidays (that can be swapped to suit you) 

- 
A fully remote-first approach ‍ within a distributed team with flexible working hours; you structure your own day 

- 
Say goodbye to meeting overload! We believe in a healthy mix of async and sync work, so you can focus on what truly matters—no more wasted time on endless meetings!

- 
Good health is important, so we offer private medical insurance, dental & vision as standard 

- 
We believe in paid parental leave to help you celebrate this important milestone, transition to your new life, and bond with your new baby. We offer 16 weeks to primary and 6 weeks to secondary caregivers, fully paid. Plus a 2-week part-time phased return at full pay to help you get used to your new (and slightly more complex!) schedule

- 
Quarterly offsites in various exciting locations as a company or team to connect, work together and have fun (so far in Tuscany Berlin Austria and Athens ).

- 
On top of this each person gets a yearly travel allowance to connect and co-work with someone or a team of people for a few days.

- 
An allowance for your at-home setup, to ensure you are happy, comfortable and productive. If you prefer a local co-working space, we’ll pay for your desk.

- 
An annual allowance for your Learning and Development needs.

- 
Work with some of the best people you’ll ever get to meet!

- 
And of course, you get some awesome Dune swag! ✌️

You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
