- Familiarity with build systems and CI/CD practices

- Comfort working with Git on a large, long-lived codebase with complex branching

What will set you apart: 

- Prior contributions to PostgreSQL or other open-source database projects

- Knowledge of distributed consensus algorithms (Raft)

- Familiarity with the PostgreSQL extension API and hook system

- Experience with high availability architectures and failover mechanisms

- Experience with Python and Rust

- Experience with the major Cloud Providers: AWS, Azure, GCP

- Experience with Ansible, Docker, and Kubernetes

title: Manager, Machine Learning Engineering
description:
About Tala 

Tala is the AI-native credit infrastructure that connects global capital to the global majority. We combine proprietary risk intelligence with an expanding network of capital and distribution partners to power credit access at scale. To date, Tala has distributed more than $9 billion in capital to more than 14 million customers across Africa, Latin America, and Asia, building the definitive contextual dataset on thin-file borrowers in emerging markets. Tala is now converting that foundation into shared infrastructure that partners, capital providers, and ecosystems can build on. 

The company has been named to the Fortune Impact 20 list, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies twice, CNBC Disruptor 50 for five years, and Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for ten years running.

Given the global nature of our team, we operate on a remote-first approach with office hubs in Santa Monica, CA (HQ); Nairobi, Kenya; Mexico City, Mexico; Manila, the Philippines; and Bangalore, India.

Most Talazens join us because they connect with our mission. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Tala, we’d love to hear from you!

The Role

We’re looking for a Manager, Machine Learning Engineering to lead Tala’s ML Platform team. This person will manage a team of Machine Learning Engineers responsible for building the platforms, frameworks, and infrastructure that enable our Data Science teams to securely train, deploy, monitor, and operate machine learning models at scale.

This is a player-coach management role. You’ll be responsible for developing and growing the team while also providing enough technical leadership to guide architecture, engineering practices, reliability, and production systems. The role has a particular focus on real-time machine learning inference and streaming data systems, as well as the platforms that support batch model development and deployment.

What You'll Do

Lead & Grow the Team 

- Manage and develop a team of 4–6 Machine Learning Engineers across mid-to-senior levels.

- Hire, source, interview, and close strong MLE talent.

- Establish clear expectations, provide regular feedback, and create development plans for direct reports.

- Coach engineers toward growth and promotion while addressing performance gaps directly and thoughtfully.

- Create opportunities for engineers to take on challenging projects and grow their technical leadership.

Own Engineering Delivery 

- Set quarterly goals and ensure the team consistently delivers against them.

- Own prioritization across product roadmap work, run-the-business activities, and operational excellence.

- Balance team capacity across new development, maintenance, technical debt, and production support.

- Improve team productivity by reducing context switching and delegating effectively.

- Partner with engineers and technical leads to estimate and scope complex work.

Provide Technical Leadership 

- Guide the development of platforms and frameworks that allow Data Scientists and Analysts to explore data, develop features, and train, test, deploy, and monitor ML models.

- Provide technical leadership across model infrastructure, real-time inference, streaming feature extraction, batch processing, and production ML systems.

- Drive strong engineering practices around testing, automation, observability, fault tolerance, infrastructure-as-code, and deployment.

- Own and improve SLOs, on-call health, capacity planning, reliability, and incident response.

- Review technical designs and help drive architectural standards and technical debt reduction.

Partner Across the Organization 

- Work closely with Data Science, Data Engineering, Data Platform, Product, Credit, and Business Development teams.

- Translate business and technical needs into scalable ML platform solutions.

- Coordinate dependencies and delivery across multiple engineering and data teams.

- Help create structure and clarity in an environment where priorities and requirements can evolve.

What You'll Need

Management Experience 

- 2+ years of directly managing engineers, including hiring, performance management, coaching, and career development.

- Experience managing a team through at least one full performance cycle.

- Demonstrated ability to coach engineers toward promotion and address underperformance effectively.

- Experience owning team goals, prioritization, estimation, and delivery.

- Experience with production on-call, incident response, and capacity planning.

- Willingness to be actively involved in sourcing, interviewing, and closing engineering talent.

Technical Experience 

- 6+ years of backend software engineering experience in consumer-scale applications.

- At least 3 years of hands-on Python experience.

- Experience building and operating machine learning or causal inference systems in production.

- Earlier-career experience personally building and deploying ML models or ML infrastructure.

- Ability to participate in technical architecture and system-design discussions and provide technical direction without needing to be the primary coder.

- Strong understanding of software quality, security, reliability, testing, and production operations.

Technical Skills 

We’re particularly interested in candidates with experience across:

- Languages: Python, SQL

- Machine Learning: Jupyter, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face

- Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker

- Streaming: Kafka, Kinesis, Beam, Flink, Spark Streaming

- Batch Processing: Airflow, Metaflow

- Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Cassandra, Snowflake, Druid, and/or similar technologies

- APIs: REST, GraphQL, gRPC, Protocol Buffers

- Production Engineering: DevOps, SLOs, monitoring/observability, on-call, capacity planning, root-cause analysis

- ML/Analytics: Machine learning, causal inference, scalable algorithms

Compensation

title: Data Engineer | Randstad
description:
Wil jij als Data Engineer werken aan uitdagende data-oplossingen bij verschillende toonaangevende organisaties, zonder de onzekerheid van losse opdrachten? Bij ITIS Projects kom je vast in dienst en werk je aan interessante dataprojecten bij opdrachtgevers in de Randstad. Zo combineer je de afwisseling van consultancy en detachering met de zekerheid, begeleiding en ontwikkelmogelijkheden van een vaste werkgever.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Data Engineer werk je vanuit ITIS Projects aan projecten bij verschillende organisaties in de Randstad. Afhankelijk van de opdracht bouw je nieuwe data-oplossingen, verbeter je bestaande data-omgevingen of help je organisaties om hun data slimmer en beter beschikbaar te maken.

Je werkt met moderne cloud- en datatechnologie en krijgt de ruimte om jezelf verder te specialiseren. Samen kijken we bovendien welke opdrachten passen bij jouw ervaring, ambities en technische interesses.

Jouw werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

- Ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van schaalbare dataplatformen en data-oplossingen.

- Bouwen, beheren en verbeteren van data pipelines.

- Integreren van verschillende databronnen in betrouwbare datamodellen.

- Automatiseren en orkestreren van dataprocessen.

- Werken met cloudplatformen zoals Azure, AWS of GCP.

- Verbeteren van datakwaliteit, performance en schaalbaarheid.

- Onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van bestaande data-omgevingen.

- Samenwerken met data-analisten, developers, architecten en stakeholders.

- Adviseren over technische keuzes en verbeteringen binnen de data-omgeving.

Wat wij je bieden

- Een vast dienstverband bij ITIS Projects .

- Een passend salaris, afhankelijk van jouw kennis, werkervaring en opleiding.

- Een leaseauto, laptop en telefoon van de zaak.

- 26 vakantiedagen op basis van een fulltime dienstverband, met de mogelijkheid om vakantiedagen te kopen of verkopen.

- Een goede pensioenregeling.

- Een opleidingsbudget om jezelf technisch en persoonlijk verder te ontwikkelen.

- Persoonlijke begeleiding vanuit fieldmanagement.

- Afwisselende data-opdrachten bij professionele organisaties in de Randstad.

- De mogelijkheid om ervaring op te doen met verschillende data stacks, cloudomgevingen en organisaties.

- Doorgroeimogelijkheden richting bijvoorbeeld Senior Data Engineer of Data Architect.

- Personeelskortingen bij verschillende bekende winkels en merken.

Wat neem je mee?

- Minimaal 3 jaar relevante ervaring als Data Engineer of in een vergelijkbare functie.

- HBO werk- en denkniveau.

- Goede kennis van SQL en Python.

- Ervaring met data orchestration, bijvoorbeeld Apache Airflow.

- Ervaring met minimaal één cloudplatform, zoals Azure, AWS of GCP.

- Kennis van moderne data tooling, bijvoorbeeld dbt, Snowflake of Fivetran.

- Ervaring met CI/CD, Docker en/of Terraform is een pré.

- Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal uitstekend, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

- Je bent analytisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en vindt het leuk om in verschillende omgevingen te werken.

Voldoe je niet aan ieder technisch punt, maar heb je wel een sterke basis als Data Engineer? Reageer dan gerust. We kijken liever naar wat je kunt én waar je naartoe wilt.

Werken bij ITIS Projects

Bij ITIS Projects kies je niet tussen zekerheid en afwisseling. Je komt bij ons vast in dienst en zet jouw kennis vervolgens in bij verschillende opdrachtgevers. Daardoor kun je aan uitdagende projecten werken en regelmatig een nieuwe technische omgeving leren kennen, terwijl je ITIS als vaste werkgever achter je hebt staan.

We kijken daarbij verder dan alleen je volgende opdracht. Samen bespreken we waar jij je technisch en persoonlijk in wilt ontwikkelen en welke projecten daarbij passen.

Wat ITIS Projects onderscheidt: 

- Vast dienstverband met afwisselende opdrachten bij externe organisaties.

- Uitdagende projecten binnen data en IT.

- Persoonlijke begeleiding tijdens jouw opdrachten.

- Ruimte voor opleidingen, certificeringen en verdere specialisatie.

- De mogelijkheid om bij verschillende organisaties en technische omgevingen ervaring op te doen.

- Een betrokken werkgever die ook tussen en tijdens opdrachten met je meedenkt over jouw volgende stap.

ITIS en de VDK Groep

ITIS is onderdeel van de VDK Groep , de razendsnel groeiende Topwerkgever van Nederland. Met inmiddels 185 bedrijven en 9.000 medewerkers biedt VDK de slagkracht en ontwikkelmogelijkheden van een grote organisatie, terwijl je bij ITIS werkt binnen een betrokken en ondernemende omgeving.

Zo profiteer je van zekerheid en volop ontwikkelmogelijkheden, terwijl je als Data Engineer de vrijheid en afwisseling houdt om aan verschillende uitdagende projecten te werken.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Payments

You’ll raise the engineering bar through architectural reviews, thoughtful approaches to technical debt, strong design practices, code quality, testing, observability, reliability and mentorship.

title: Senior Technical Business Analyst
description:
Working at CreateFuture 

CreateFuture is an AI-native consulting partner where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference while always putting people first.

We’re a team of creators. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people. We work side by side with our clients, challenging what’s not working and helping them to build the future. Our commitment to craft, quality, and culture has helped us scale to over 600 people in just a few years.

CreateFuture is a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company and has won Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row.

Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today.

About the role and team: 
CreateFuture is looking for a collaborative, technically grounded Senior Business Analyst to join our team.

Our Senior Business Analysts drive high-impact change across a broad spectrum of client engagements. While we deliver end-to-end digital products, this role is tailored for a BA who is as comfortable driving complex back-end environments (such as API integrations, platform migrations, data architecture, and system integration logic) as they are crafting front-end user experiences and feature specifications.

You’ll leverage your proficiency in business analysis, system architecture, and product strategy to guide project development, acting as the crucial bridge between technical and non-technical stakeholders. Your responsibilities span meticulous requirements analysis, data flow mapping, estimation, and championing delivery best practices within your team.

Your exceptional communication skills are pivotal for translating complex client objectives into clear, developer-ready specifications and data flows, ensuring what we build is both valuable for users and technically robust under the hood.

Does this sound like you? Do you have a passion for the craft of Business Analysis, a natural curiosity for how complex backend systems work, and an interest in how modern tools are changing how we work? If so, we’d love to talk to you.

What you'll be doing: 

- Evaluate current and emerging business procedures, collaborating with clients and internal teams to propose impactful system solutions and process improvements.

- Proactively bring cross-functional teams together to shape user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and technical specifications (including API contracts, payload logic, and data mappings).

- Facilitate data analysis, query system data to uncover edge cases, and map complex integration dependencies across backend architecture.

- Manage project backlogs during discovery, build, and run phases, balancing business priorities against technical constraints, non-functional requirements (NFRs), and engineering effort.

- Support and lead client discovery conversations, driving estimation efforts, facilitating workshops, and championing best practices across your project team.

We'd love to talk to you if you have: 

- Proven experience delivering both product-led user initiatives and complex technical projects (e.g., API integrations, platform migrations, data architecture).

- Experience working for a Consultancy or Client facing environment

- Strong experience as a Technical Business Analyst working closely with engineering, architecture and product teams.

- Experience working with data, including data mapping, data models, databases and ideally SQL.

- A strong track record of working alongside engineering teams to analyse data flows, system logic, and technical dependencies.

- A user-centric mindset that ensures backend architectural choices directly support a seamless end-user experience.

- Proven ability to bridge the gap between technical and non-technical stakeholders, gaining a deep understanding of business context and translating complex goals into clear. specifications.

- Bring meticulous requirements analysis, lead estimation efforts, and champion best practices across your project team.

Bonus points if you have: 

- Experimented with AI tools to accelerate research, draft baseline specifications, map data fields, or red-team edge cases in system flows.

- Exposure to or curiosity about how modern AI capabilities, LLMs, or agentic workflows integrate into backend system architectures.

- A proactive approach to exploring new tools and techniques that improve the speed and quality of business analysis, with a desire to share those learnings with colleagues.

You don’t need to arrive as an AI expert. If you haven’t yet had much opportunity to put AI into practice in your BA work, that shouldn’t stop you from applying. What matters to us is curiosity, a willingness to experiment, and a commitment to high-quality analysis. Everyone at CreateFuture undertakes AI-native training, and we’ll support you to build these capabilities and put them into practice. 

What we’ll offer you: 

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Our hiring process 

We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.

It usually looks like this:

- Call with our Talent Acquisition Team 

- Role specific capability interview 

Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.

Inclusion at CreateFuture 

We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.

If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just. We will do what we can to help.

We look forward to your application!

Le SGDT (Système de Gestion des Dossiers Techniques) est un outil interne utilisé pour gérer les dossiers techniques (RDO) associés à une structure produit (PBS) composée de sous-ensembles et de composants. La version actuelle repose sur un classeur Excel/VBA développé en interne, aujourd'hui fonctionnel mais limité en termes d'évolutivité, de travail collaboratif et de gestion des accès.

Une refonte web de l'outil a été initiée : architecture posée, environnement de développement en place, spécification fonctionnelle rédigée (CDC v1.0) et modèle de gestion des droits par rôle (RBAC) conçu. L'objectif du stage est de reprendre ce socle, poursuivre le développement et amener l'outil à un niveau de finalisation permettant sa mise en production , en remplacement progressif de l'outil VBA/Excel existant.

Missions: 

Rattaché(e) à l'ingénieur ayant initié le projet, vous serez responsable du développement de bout en bout de la nouvelle plateforme :

- Prendre en main l'existant : architecture, spécification fonctionnelle, modèle de données et base de code déjà initiée

- Développer le back-end (API, logique métier, persistance des données)

- Développer le front-end (interface utilisateur, ergonomie, navigation dans la structure produit)

- Implémenter la gestion des droits par rôle (RBAC)

- Reprendre les fonctionnalités clés de l'outil VBA existant (import de structure produit, génération de listes documentaires, gestion des statuts et indices de documents, historique/traçabilité) et les adapter à l'architecture web

- Mettre en place les tests (unitaires / fonctionnels) et documenter le code et les choix techniques

- Participer aux phases de validation avec les utilisateurs métier et itérer sur les retours

- Contribuer à la finalisation du déploiement de l'outil

Profil recherché: 

- Étudiant(e) en école d'ingénieur ou master, spécialisation informatique / développement logiciel, à la recherche d'un stage de fin d'études (6 mois)

- Bonne maîtrise de Python et d'un framework web back-end (FastAPI, Django ou équivalent)

- Bonne maîtrise de React (ou forte motivation à monter en compétence rapidement)

- Connaissances en modélisation de données et bases relationnelles

- À l'aise pour travailler en autonomie sur un projet existant, en comprendre la logique métier et en assurer la continuité

- Rigueur, sens de la documentation, capacité à dialoguer avec des utilisateurs non-développeurs

- Une sensibilité pour les problématiques industrielles / gestion documentaire est un plus

title: AI Experience Engineer (Conversational AI)
description:
Headquarters: Canada (Remote)

About the Role: 

An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human. 

We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics. 

Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences. 

Our Core Technologies 

Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools. 

What You'll Do 

• Journey creation: Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout 

• Optimization: Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge 

• Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff 

• Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most 

• Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs 

• Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers 

• Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context 

• Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior 

• Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts 

• Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone 

• Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks 

What We Look For: 

• 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles 

• Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails 

• Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates 

• Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes 

• Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms. 

• Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved 

• Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response 

• Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal 

Nice To Have: 

• Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect) 

• Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling 

• Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design 

• Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2) 

• Conversation design or UX writing experience 

What We Offer You: 

• Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan 

• Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance 

• Flexible PTO 

• Opportunities for professional growth and development
• Paid parental leave 

• Health & wellness initiatives

title: Software Engineer, Backend
description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. 

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the role

You’ll build backend systems that make our lab programmable. You'll architect data pipelines that process large-scale protein characterization data, build APIs that integrate laboratory instruments and robotics into our software stack, and work closely with scientists and automation engineers to translate complex molecular biology workflows into reliable, scalable software. This is not SaaS slop, you're making physical machines do precise biology with minimal human intervention.

What we're looking for 

- Strong experience designing and building production backend systems. We use Python and TypeScript on the backend with Postgres, but what matters is that you can architect systems that are reliable and maintainable.

- Experience building data pipelines and processing infrastructure. You'll be handling large volumes of heterogeneous data from physical instruments such as binding kinetics data, enzyme activity measurements, chromatography readings, and turning them into clean, structured datasets.

- Comfortable with API design and systems integration. A big part of this role is making hardware talk to software: connecting instruments, robotics, and scheduling systems into a coherent whole.

- A genuine interest in biology. No background required, but our product is running biology experiments in the physical world and that should excite you.

- High-autonomy, founder mindset. We share context and vision openly. You figure out what matters most and go work on it.

- Pragmatism. You care about solving the problem well, not about the stack or the tools.

- You write code primarily with AI, but you have enough experience writing software without it to know what good code and good architecture look like.

Application deadline 

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

title: International Expansion
description:
About Us 

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here .

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the Dutch market. 

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.

This role will assess Axle’s participation in Dutch markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.

You speak Dutch and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing 

- Owning new customer acquisition end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, setting our partners up to generate meaningful revenue.

- High-level strategy development, defining and executing Axle’s international expansion plans, and assessing the commercial value of Dutch markets and business models.

- Diving deep into policy and regulations, understanding how market access works and what needs doing to achieve it.

- Developing the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships with key stakeholders. You’ll be jumping on the phone (and eventually, getting on the ground) with grid operators, utilities/retailers and potential clients to create and disprove hypotheses as quickly as possible.

- Acting as a conduit between partners and engineering teams creating fast, structured feedback loops that help translate field insights into meaningful product enhancements.

As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets.

You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments.

This is an opportunity to repeatedly deliver first-of-a-kind projects across the world, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of global electrification.

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

You’ll be based in the Netherlands. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process 

- Initial interview

- Take-home exercise

- Final interview (in-person)

- Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

Als Medior Data & Analytics Consultant ben je de drijvende kracht achter de data-oplossingen voor onze klanten. Je bent niet alleen de expert in het Google ecosysteem, maar ook de adviseur die complexe data-uitdagingen van A tot Z oplost. 

Wat je gaat doen 

Je neemt eigenaarschap over je projecten en speelt een actieve rol in het naar een hoger niveau tillen van onze data-volwassenheid, zowel intern als extern. Je beheert een eigen project- en klantportfolio. 

Concreet betekent dat: 

- Strategisch advies en complexe oplossingen: Je fungeert als sparringpartner voor klanten en collega’s, waarbij je proactief advies geeft en complexe data-implementatie- en analysevraagstukken zelfstandig oplost. Dit gaat verder dan support: je adviseert over de beste aanpak voor de lange termijn. 

- Inzichten vertalen naar actie: Je presenteert jouw bevindingen aan klanten en collega’s, waarbij je de technische analyse vertaalt naar duidelijke, commerciële aanbevelingen. Je denkt mee over de optimalisatie van marketing- en businessprocessen. 

- Proactieve kwaliteitsborging: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de betrouwbaarheid en consistentie van alle data. Je stelt kwaliteitsstandaarden op, voert audits uit en implementeert structurele verbeteringen in de data-architectuur van klanten. 

- Procesoptimalisatie & innovatie: Je bent een belangrijke aanjager van interne verbeteringen. Je identificeert knelpunten en implementeert slimme automatiseringen en AI-toepassingen om onze werkprocessen efficiënter en schaalbaarder te maken. Je deelt actief je kennis met het team. 

- Diepgaande data-analyse en rapportage: Je voert complexe data-analyses uit in tools zoals BigQuery en Spreadsheets om trends, kansen en knelpunten te identificeren. Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt overzichtelijke en impactvolle dashboards en rapportages (o.a. in Looker Studio) die de business performance inzichtelijk maken. 

Wat we bieden 

- Een salaris tussen de €3.250 en €4.500, afhankelijk van je ervaring. 

- Een eigen portfolio met een aantal toffe klanten en projecten. 

- Ruimte voor eigen initiatief, groei en innovatie. 

- 26 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de mogelijkheid om er 5 bij te kopen. 

- Een eenmalig thuiswerkbudget tot €1.000 om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten. 

- Een goed geregeld pensioen, zonder eigen bijdrage. 

- De vrijheid om hybride te werken, zodat jij het best tot je recht komt. 

- Interne kennissessies en deep-dives waarin we kennis delen en van elkaar leren. 

Dit ben jij 

Je bent een ervaren consultant die technische complexiteit moeiteloos vertaalt naar heldere business taal. Je werkt gestructureerd, ziet het grotere plaatje en durft beslissingen te nemen. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende: 

- Je hebt minimaal 2-4 jaar relevante werkervaring in een vergelijkbare rol. 

- Je bent communicatief sterk op verschillende niveaus: je kunt schakelen met developers over technische implementaties én met marketing managers over KPI’s. 

- Je hebt diepgaande kennis van het Google ecosysteem: GA4, Google Tag Manager (server-side is een pré), Looker Studio, BigQuery en Spreadsheets kennen voor jou weinig geheimen. 

- Je hebt ervaring met (of een sterke interesse in) het automatiseren van data via SQL en/of Python. Kennis van SQL en/of Python is een grote pré. 

- Je neemt initiatief om onze werkwijze naar een hoger niveau te tillen en denkt mee over hoe we processen kunnen verbeteren, bijvoorbeeld met automatisering of de inzet van slimme tools zoals AI. 

Waarom Follo? 

Follo is een data-gedreven bureau met zo’n 150 collega’s verdeeld over 4 kantoren in Utrecht, Dongen, Groningen en Gent, en was dit jaar het meest genomineerde bureau bij de European Search Awards. Data is bij ons geen ondersteunende functie, maar de basis onder alles wat we voor klanten doen. Met ons eigen platform, de FolloEngine, automatiseren we het zware werk, zodat jij meer tijd hebt voor analyse, advies en impact. 

Zin om bij Follo te werken? 

Meld je dan direct aan. Heb je nog vragen? Stuur onze recruiter een mail via . Tot snel!

title: Data/ML engineer, fusion data
description:
Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation, and control stack for the fusion energy reactors of the future.

Spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and backed by top investors, our technology enables reliable operation, real-time monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices. We are founded by world-class experts at the intersection of fusion physics, advanced control, and AI (ex-Google DeepMind, EPFL). We are assembling a founding engineering team in Lausanne to build our core technology platform.

We are looking for a Data / Machine Learning Engineer to join our team. This job is for you if you like turning large, messy, heterogeneous experimental data into clean, labelled, trustworthy datasets. You have done this with scientific or industrial sensor data. Familiarity with fusion is a plus but not a strict requirement.

Responsibilities

- Build, maintain and run pipelines that bring experimental fusion data into high quality, consistent, documented, versioned datasets.

- Develop ML-assisted labelling and event detection (e.g. disruptions, MHD activity, diagnostic faults), using weak supervision, active learning and anomaly detection.

- Own data quality and provisioning: provenance, calibration metadata, automated validation. Manage and facilitate access for the rest of the team.

- Work with physicists validating the datasets & labels.

- Work with our computational scientists and control engineers, who build models and controllers on these datasets, and with customers to understand and integrate their data.

Requirements

- Hands-on experience building data pipelines for large scientific or industrial time-series data formats (e.g. HDF5, Parquet, Zarr).

- Proficiency in designing, querying and optimizing SQL and noSQL database systems and familiarity with Time Series databases such as TimescaleDB, InfluxDB.

- Experience in applying ML techniques to time series in Python (PyTorch or JAX): sequence models, anomaly and event detection, semi- or weakly-supervised labelling.

- Solid software engineering habits: testing, reproducibility, data versioning are second nature to you.

- Evidence of independent work at the highest level: a PhD thesis and/or published code that is used by others, or an industry project you owned. You should be comfortable designing data architectures independently from day 1.

- The following are an advantage but not strictly required:

- Human-in-the-loop labelling tools and workflows.

- Pipeline Orchestration (e.g. Dagster, Airflow, Prefect) and data versioning (e.g. DVC, lakeFS).

- Data from large physics experiments: fusion, accelerators, astronomy, or exposure to fusion data systems (MDSplus, IMAS).

What we offer

- Play a key role at a dynamic, fast-growing startup, shaping the technical solutions and products from the ground up.

- Build cutting edge technology to monitor and control plasmas in real fusion devices, working side-by-side with leading plasma and control experts.

- Great working conditions, located in Lausanne, Switzerland, a city and country known for its high quality of life.

- Competitive salary and equity compensation, matched to level of seniority, and benefits including immigration assistance.

title: Full-Stack Growth Engineer
description:
About Us: 

Future is building a personalized guidance system for lifelong health. We help people understand what to do next for their body, goals, and stage of life — then support them in turning those decisions into sustained behavior change. By combining AI, human expertise, personal health data, and accountability, Future helps members improve performance today while building the resilience, capacity, and healthspan they need for decades to come.

About the Role:

We’re hiring a Full-Stack Growth Engineer to build and maintain the product and systems that help more of the right people discover Future, convert into members, and reach their first moments of value.

You’ll work across web and backend surfaces that power acquisition, signup and access, onboarding and activation, and early engagement. You’ll ship experiments end to end, instrument funnels carefully, and partner closely with product, design, data, and marketing on a small, senior team.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll move between product judgment and system design, write production code, run trustworthy experiments, and turn learnings into durable product improvements — not one-off hacks.

What You’ll Own:

- Acquisition and Conversion: Build and improve the web and product surfaces that introduce Future to prospective members and turn interest into signup. These include landing experiences, checkout and plan selection flows, and the instrumentation that shows where people drop off.

- Access and Onboarding: Simplify signup, login, account creation, and first-session activation. Remove friction, clarify value on Day 1, and help new members connect with coaching and get started quickly.

- Experimentation Systems: Design, ship, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across the funnel. Partner with data to define metrics, guardrails, and experiment hygiene so we learn fast without polluting the product.

- Full-Stack Delivery : Implement features across frontend and backend — APIs, services, web UI, and the glue between growth surfaces and the core member product. Prefer clear ownership and fast iteration over brittle one-off paths.

- Measurement and Insight: Instrument funnels, cohorts, and activation milestones. Use qualitative and quantitative signal to find leverage, prioritize work, and explain why experiments won or lost.

- Reliability for Growth Paths: Keep high-traffic growth journeys fast, stable, and observable. Treat conversion-critical paths with the same engineering care as core product.

- Cross-Functional Partnership: Work tightly with product, design, data, and marketing. Translate growth hypotheses into shippable product work and bring engineering judgment into roadmap tradeoffs.

- AI-Assisted Development: Use coding agents and AI tools to speed up exploration, implementation, testing, and review. Apply engineering judgment to validate their output before it reaches members or prospects.

Who You Are:

Experience and Background

- You have 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including meaningful ownership of consumer growth, acquisition, activation, or conversion surfaces.

- You are strong full-stack: comfortable across modern web frontend and backend services, and able to ship an experiment from UI through API and data without waiting on another team for every layer.

- You have run growth experiments in production — A/B tests, funnel instrumentation, and iteration based on measured outcomes, not vibes alone.

- You understand customer journeys: segments, touchpoints, dropoff analysis, and how product changes move activation and retention metrics.

- You can debug across web UI, networking, backend services, analytics pipelines, and CI.

- You have partnered with product, design, and data (or marketing) to take ambiguous growth problems from hypothesis to shipped learning.

- You write clear, maintainable code and care about experiment integrity, observability, and long-term operability — not just shipping the next test.

- You use AI coding tools in your development workflow and know how to verify their output.

Domain Passion

You care about health, fitness, and helping people start — and stick with — better habits. You’re motivated by the craft of turning curiosity into membership and first value.

Working Style

- You bias to action, then measure. You ship small, learn, and compound.

- You raise concerns early and bring possible solutions when experiments or funnels look wrong.

- You share context, invite feedback, and keep partners aligned on metrics and tradeoffs.

- You take ownership from discovery through production support on the paths you ship.

- You balance growth urgency with product quality and member trust.

Nice to Have 

- Experience at a consumer subscription, marketplace, or membership product where acquisition and activation were core to the business.

- Familiarity with HIPAA and other laws and regulations that apply to health products and services.

- Experience with paid acquisition landing systems, attribution, SEO/organic surfaces, lifecycle messaging, or referral loops.

- Experience building or evolving experimentation platforms, feature flags, or analytics instrumentation at scale.

- Experience with fitness, health, coaching, or other personalized consumer products.

- Prior work on expert tooling, internal operator workflows, or coach-facing surfaces that support member outcomes.

Compensation, Benefits & Life at Future: 

- Salary range: $200,000 - 230,000 / year + equity. The salary range is set based on multiple considerations including business needs, market demands, talent availability, experience, and unique skills and attributes. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. 

- Health coverage: All employees have access to comprehensive medical, vision, dental, and disability insurance + tax savings accounts 

- 401(k) plan

- Flexible Paid Time Off

- Future Membership: Enjoy our platform for free! 

- Health, Wellness & Development: Health and fitness monthly stipend contributes to our employees’ overall wellbeing, with access to a mental health platform, reimbursement for medical travel, and an annual learning & development stipend. 

- Remote First: Employment eligible to employees located anywhere in the continental US. No travel required. 

- Join a diverse, passionate & driven team of all backgrounds.

Life at Future 

Equity: Meaningful equity package.
Health Coverage: All employees who meet eligibility requirements receive comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and disability insurance, plus tax-advantaged savings accounts.
Retirement: 401(k) plan.
Wellness: Monthly wellness stipend for fitness, recovery, and overall wellbeing, plus access to mental health resources and therapy support.
Flexible Time Off: Flexible PTO so you can rest, recharge, and take care of life outside of work.
Learning & Development: Annual budget for courses, conferences, coaching, and tools that help you grow in your craft.
Future Membership: Enjoy our platform for free.

Equal Employment Opportunities at Future 

We are committed to building a future where every member of our community, is healthy, cared for, and advancing forward together. Future is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, age, civil or family status, disability or race.

title: Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
About Papers

Papers AG is a Swiss cyber security engineering house and an incubator for our product portfolio. We build device-level alternatives to centralized cloud and trust. Our strategy is to grow our foundational decentralized network by building high-demand enterprise products directly on top of it.

Your portfolio includes:

- Acurast: Decentralized confidential compute running on ordinary smartphones.

- Obsidio: A continuous, AI-assisted pentesting subscription. Incubated by Papers, Obsidio is built directly on Acurast, leveraging the decentralized network as a unique compute moat to battle-test networks.

- Hypergate: Enterprise mobile single sign-on for managed Android and iOS fleets.

As an engineering-driven team, we work with autonomy and purpose. Our culture is built on meritocracy, long-term thinking, and a commitment to quality over buzz, innovation is in our DNA. We aim to collaborate with people who love tech for its own sake and want to help shape the future by solving real-world challenges.

Your role

We are seeking a tech-savvy, execution-oriented Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist to serve as the engine powering our growth campaigns, content infrastructure, and data analytics pipeline.

Your main goal will be to communicate our stories across a portfolio of brands by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI, data operations, and tactical growth marketing. You’ll be building automated content workflows, ensuring the highest quality across everything we generate, running multi-channel campaigns from start to finish, and maintaining rock-solid attribution tracking.

If you are obsessed with efficiency, operational speed, and using AI to scale output without ever sacrificing quality and if you thrive when given a blank slate to write your own playbook, this role is for you.

Success Metrics (First 90 Days) 

- 30 Days: Take full ownership of the existing marketing tech stack and establish baseline performance metrics.

- 60 Days: Fully automate the core content generation pipeline and establish QA workflows.

- 90 Days: Launch at least two multi-channel growth experiments and demonstrate a measurable reduction in CAC or an increase in content throughput.

Core Responsibilities 

1. Storytelling That Converts 

- Making Complexity Clear: Take complex, often highly technical capabilities and features and turn them into clear, digestible stories without losing accuracy.

- Audience-First Messaging: Understand who the campaigns speak to (developers, technical decision-makers, business stakeholders or end users) and frame each capability around what that audience cares about, at the right level of technical depth.

- Spark Curiosity & Action: Craft narratives that get audiences interested and excited, and that move them to the desired conversion.

- Product & Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with product and engineering teams to deeply understand what is being built, so every story is both compelling and technically correct.

2. Tactical Deployment & Agile Execution 

- Multi-Channel Campaign Launch: Execute and launch integrated campaigns across communities, social channels, search, newsletters, loyalty programs, influencers, paid ads and landing pages. Where needed, bring in and coordinate additional third parties to support execution, such as external PR firms and campaign support providers.

- Marketing Automation: Maintain and scale lifecycle workflows, lead scoring mechanisms, drip sequences, and automated triggers to optimize lead conversion through the relevant funnel.

- Rapid A/B & Multivariate Testing: Design, set up, and evaluate rapid growth experiments (copy variants, landing page layouts, audience segmentation, offer positioning) on a weekly sprint cycle.

3. AI Pipeline Operation & Content QA 

- Automated Workflow Orchestration: Build, maintain, and optimize AI-driven content pipelines to generate high-quality marketing assets at scale.

- Human-in-the-Loop Quality Assurance: Establish strict QA processes to review, refine, and approve AI-generated copy, visual assets, landing page content, and email sequences before deployment.

- Prompt Engineering & Template Optimization: Continuously iterate on, standardize, and version-control skills, design systems and context workflows to ensure output matches brand voice, compliance standards, and conversion best practices.

- Scale & Efficiency Metrics: Track content throughput, error rates, and time-to-market reduction, driving continuous improvement in pipeline efficiency.

title: Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention & Investigations
description:
Headquarters: Remote - USA

Clover Health is investing in our fraud detection and investigation capabilities and is seeking a Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention & Investigations to join our Legal department as a senior individual contributor. This hybrid role combines: (1) managing hands-on investigations of potential provider fraud with (2) building AI-powered tools and processes to make investigations more efficient and help catch potential future fraud earlier. You will develop and pilot new AI-enabled investigatory processes for Clover’s Medicare Advantage business, and own resulting investigations, in collaboration with Clover’s Special Investigations Unit (SIU) and other stakeholders.

This is a non-attorney role. You will work hand-in-hand with Clover’s lawyers and SIU to ensure that new investigatory processes you develop, and the resulting investigations, comply with Clover policies and regulatory requirements. Success in this role requires someone sharp, creative, and technically hands-on—someone who does not just use existing analytics tools but builds their own. That might mean writing a script to automate repetitive work, pulling apart a dataset when a standard report falls short, or working with an LLM until it produces something genuinely useful—all with the goal of finding smarter, more effective ways to investigate potential provider fraud.

As a Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention & Investigations, you will: 

- Build Your Own Investigative Tooling: Use AI to write the queries, scripts, and prompts that turn millions of claim lines and/or medical record data into a prioritized list of leads. Prototype detection logic yourself rather than waiting on a roadmap, and hand off what works to data science and engineering to productionize. We expect you to be the person who builds v1.

- Investigate Potential Fraud End-to-End With AI in the Loop: Own a portfolio of fraud investigations sourced using the tooling you develop, in collaboration with Clover’s SIU. Develop investigative plans, gather and analyze evidence (including claims data and medical records), and reach well-supported conclusions. Use LLMs and analytics to compress the parts of an investigation that have always been slow — reading unstructured data, triaging grievance narratives, and sizing exposure. 

- Build Defensible Documentation: Develop case files and memos that are factually complete, well-organized, and prepared with the evidentiary and procedural standards necessary for downstream enforcement, recoveries, or provider actions.

- Collaborate Across Functions: Work with Clover's clinical, compliance, claims, payment integrity, provider relations, revenue operations, and SIU teams to gather information, validate findings, and translate investigative outcomes into operational improvements, provider education, and member impact.

- Communicate Findings Clearly: Prepare concise written reports and oral briefings that translate complex investigative facts into clear narratives for senior leadership and other stakeholders.

Success in this role looks like: 

- In your first 90 days , you have embedded yourself as a trusted partner to both the Legal department and Clover’s SIU. You have built working relationships with key stakeholders across Clover's clinical, compliance, claims, payment integrity, revenue operations, and legal teams, and you have begun working through your initial portfolio of fraud investigations and ad hoc referrals.

- By 6 months , you are independently managing a steady caseload of fraud investigations with consistently high-quality work product, in collaboration with SIU. You have a clear working rhythm with Legal and SIU, and you have built at least one working tool — a script, a notebook, a dashboard, a prompt.

- By 12 months , you have a track record of strong investigations, successful recoveries and/or referrals, and effective cross-functional collaboration. Senior leaders across Clover view you as a trusted person to call when they have a hunch that something doesn't look right and want it examined.

You should get in touch if: 

- Knowledge of healthcare fraud schemes & investigative experience: You have experience in healthcare fraud investigations, program integrity, or SIU operations, ideally within Medicare Advantage or managed care. You understand healthcare fraud schemes and know how to use claims data, medical records, and provider documentation to build a defensible factual record.

- You are AI-native and enjoy building things using LLMs: You can use LLMs to write SQL, Python, etc., to interrogate large claims and/or medical record datasets, automate investigative work, and prototype your own solutions rather than waiting for someone else to build them. We do not expect production-grade engineering or require formal technical training—we value demonstrated ability to build, ship, and showcase solutions that work. 

- Strong communication skills: You are a strong writer and communicator who can turn complex investigative findings into clear memos, referrals, and executive summaries, and you are comfortable building in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.

Bonus points if: 

- 

- You have built something people actually use—an internal tool, detection model, script, automation, or AI workflow that made a manual process better. We would rather see something scrappy and useful in production than something polished in a slide.

- You have hands-on experience applying AI/ML to fraud, investigations, or compliance.

- You have a J.D., legal training, or experience working alongside Legal, SIU, or compliance at a health plan.

- You have industry certifications such as CFE, AHFI, or CHC.

Benefits Overview :

- Financial Well-Being : Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.

- Physical Well-Being : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.

- Mental Well-Being : We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location. 

- Professional Development : Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks: 

- Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities

- Reimbursement for office setup expenses

- Monthly cell phone & internet stipend

- Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams

- Paid parental leave for all new parents

- And much more!

About Clover: We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most.

We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare.

From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

title: Senior Partner Engineer
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV 

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

About the team 

The Partner Engineering team’s vision is to establish Roku as the preferred platform of choice for our partners (media companies) to distribute and monetize their content globally. The Partner Engineering team’s mission is to be the technical advocate and point of contact for the Partner’s Engineering organization within Roku to help them deliver the best content viewing experience globally for the Roku user community. On a day-to-day basis, we work with engineers from partners organization to help them develop, test, certify, and launch partners direct-to-consumer (DTC) apps in compliance with the Roku platform distribution agreement. We represent partners’ roadmap and technical needs by working cross-functionally with the assigned Partner Engagement Managers, product and engineering teams within Roku. 

About the role 

Roku's platform is live across the multiple European countries, and our European footprint is growing — through Roku TV licensing partners, through our own streaming hardware, and through the local broadcasters and streaming services that make the platform worth owning in each market. 

You will be the senior engineer for our European partners: the person who makes their apps fast, stable and certifiable on Roku, who represents their technical constraints to our platform and OS teams, and who makes each new market launch a technical success rather than a scramble. 

You will be the engineer for a portfolio of European partners — public service and commercial broadcasters, subscription streaming services and pay-TV operators — working with the Partner Engineering team in San Jose and with the Partner Engagement Manager in London who owns those partners’ relationships. You will debug crashes, memory and launch-time issues, diagnose partner-reported streaming problems, and give your partners hands-on support through Roku certification. 

How you’ll work with the Partner Engagement Manager. The Partner Engagement Manager from Roku owns the partner relationship, the launch plan and timeline, partner priorities, and communication during incidents. You own the technical diagnosis, the integration work, and technical sign-off on certification and launch readiness, working engineer to engineer with the partner’s technical team. When something breaks, the Partner Engagement Manager coordinates the response and keeps the partner informed; you find the root cause and the path to a fix. 

Level: Senior individual contributor, with no direct reports. 

Reports to: Director, Partner Engineering, based in San Jose. 

Location and work arrangement: London, UK, in the office Monday to Thursday, with flexible Fridays. Travel within Europe up to 40% of your time. Regular late-afternoon calls with San Jose, whose working day starts at 4pm UK time. 

On-call: For major partner launches and live events, the Partner Engagement Manager is the on-call escalation point and brings this role in for technical diagnosis, which can mean occasional work outside normal hours. 

Expected impact: European partners’ apps pass certification and launch without technical surprises. Additionally, you’ll own the stability, performance and engagement metrics for your partners' apps, and keep each at or better than its benchmark: Roku's certification thresholds and the best-performing apps on the platform. 

- Stability: crash rate, unexpected app closures and out-of-memory terminations 

- Performance: launch time, video start time, video start and playback failures, and rebuffering 

- Engagement: streaming hours per subscriber 

- App Certification and public release: time from technical onboarding to launch in each new market 

- Incidents: platform-caused incidents affecting your partners' apps, and time to resolve them 

What you'll do 

European market expansion 

- Sign off the technical readiness of each new market launch. The Partner Engagement Manager owns the launch plan and timeline; you work with Channel Publishing and Certification to get global and local broadcasters and streaming services onto the platform ahead of a market opening — scoping integrations, running technical onboarding, and clearing the issues that would otherwise surface on launch day. Then write down what “technically ready” meant for that market, so the next launch is faster and cheaper.

Roku’s certification team runs the review; you give the technical sign-off that the app is ready.

title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
description:
Senior AI/ML Engineer, remote in Canada: own the AI that assesses patients for US healthcare providers and gets them to the right mental health care faster. 

About Limbic 

Limbic’s vision is to ensure the highest quality therapy is accessible to everyone, everywhere.

Limbic has supported more than 820,000 patients across the UK and the US. We are used in over 50% of NHS Talking Therapies services, which makes us the largest-ever deployment of generative AI for direct patient care, and our AI now delivers end-to-end therapy to patients in the US under the supervision of licensed clinicians.

Safety and science come first. We are the only AI mental health chatbot with UKCA Class IIa medical device certification, and the first AI-led mental healthcare company selected for the FDA’s TEMPO pilot. Our results are published in leading scientific journals: in a randomized, double-blind trial published in Nature Medicine, our AI agents scored higher than licensed CBT therapists on a standard measure of therapy skill.

The Role 

As a Senior AI/ML Engineer, you will take ownership of the AI in our clinical assessment product for US healthcare organizations. A patient describes what they are struggling with in a conversation with our AI, which gathers their history, administers standard clinical questionnaires such as PHQ-9 and GAD-7, detects risk and recommends a treatment program for the organization’s clinicians to review. Every organization configures it for its own services, so the AI has to be safe and accurate across many clinical setups, not just one.

The approach is proven at scale in the NHS, where it increased referrals from minority groups by 29%, as published in Nature Medicine. You will work in North American hours alongside product, engineering and clinical colleagues, in close collaboration with our ML team in London. Our AI products are built on shared platforms for agents, evaluation and safety, so the systems you design are reused across Limbic.

What You’ll Do 

- 
Own the quality of the conversational AI that runs patient assessments, from each step of the conversation to clinical prediction and treatment recommendation.

- 
Improve the safety checks that screen every patient message and AI reply, covering risk, attempts to manipulate the AI, unsafe medical advice and clinically inappropriate responses, so they catch more problems without flagging good replies.

- 
Productionize ML models that optimize product KPIs, including the accuracy of clinical predictions and how quickly patients reach the right care.

- 
Build and maintain evaluation harnesses, simulated patient conversations and labelled transcript review, so every configuration can be tested before a patient sees it.

- 
Extend our assessment AI to new channels, including the phone, so that patients who cannot or will not use a web form still have a way in.

- 
Help turn our clinical AI into composable services that healthcare partners can integrate into their own patient journeys.

- 
Build agents and tooling that automate product development workflows, including reliable testing and customer demos.

- 
Raise the engineering bar through architecture, code review and mentorship, while keeping our AI continuously compliant with strict regulatory requirements.

What You’ll Bring 

- 
You must meet one of the following educational and experience backgrounds:

- 
A PhD in computational science or an AI-related field, plus 2 years of experience in an ML engineering role.

- 
OR A BSc/MSc, plus 4 years of experience in an ML engineering role.

- 
Expertise in productizing LLM features and a strong background in eval-driven development.

- 
Expert-level proficiency in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript.

- 
Proven experience building an LLM agent harness .

- 
Experience utilizing reinforcement learning.

- 
Strong architectural skills with experience designing scalable, production-grade systems for machine learning applications.

- 
A solid understanding of statistical principles in the context of LLM evaluation and user activity analytics.

- 
Proficiency with version control systems (preferably Git) and databases (SQL or NoSQL).

- 
Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform and containerization technologies.

- 
A track record of end-to-end ownership: you scope work you can ship quickly, measure its impact, and keep a sense of urgency when the stakes are high.

- 
A genuine interest in applying your technical skills to solve complex challenges in the mental healthcare space.

- 
Ideal but not required: Experience with real-time voice AI, or with healthcare organizations as customers.

- 
North American business hours (Eastern time preferred), with daily overlap with colleagues in Europe (UTC to UTC+3).

- 
Based in Canada with the right to work there.

- 
Please note: Limbic cannot provide visa sponsorship in Canada.

Benefits & Wellbeing 

- 
Salary: CA$173,000 – CA$192,000 per year.

- 
Equity share options.

- 
25 days PTO.

- 
Support with purchasing work-related books and materials.

- 
Quarterly Life Days: Enjoy 4 paid days off per year (one each quarter) to use whenever you choose to relax, recharge, or take care of personal matters.

- 
Mental Health Support: Access to dedicated mental health support services.

We encourage women and individuals from diverse backgrounds to apply and join our team. We believe in creating an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone can contribute their best.

title: IoT Engineer
description:
Do you enjoy working across the full IoT stack? In this role you’ll design embedded firmware for low-power devices, connect them through BLE, LoRa or Cellular, and build the cloud architecture and fleet management systems that run them at scale.

You’ll work closely with firmware, hardware and cloud colleagues, shape our CI/CD pipelines, and help improve how we build and deploy as we grow. It’s a hands-on role for someone who likes variety and wants to see their work running in real shipments.

📍 Location: We need you to be within commutable distance to Basel given the role requires 50%+ time spent on-site.

Founded in Switzerland in 2012, SkyCell is transforming global pharmaceutical supply chains through a combination of advanced temperature-controlled containers, IoT connectivity, and digital solutions.

Our integrated product ecosystem helps leading pharmaceutical companies reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and ensure the safe delivery of life-saving medicines worldwide.

Today, SkyCell operates at the intersection of hardware, software, data, and logistics - combining Swiss engineering excellence with a growing digital platform to shape the future of connected pharma supply chains.

Why SkyCell? 

🌱 Purpose-Driven Work: Make a real difference by contributing to a more sustainable future in global logistics and healthcare.

🚀 Innovation at Heart: Work with cutting-edge technology and be at the forefront of supply chain innovation.

🌎 Stronger together: Join a supportive team of talented individuals from over 40 countries, where we work together every step of the way.

💡 Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in our people – continuous learning and development are key pillars of SkyCell.

🏆 Award-Winning Culture: Join a workplace recognized for its commitment to excellence with a ‘Great Place to work’ award, as well as a Platinum Ecovadis rating highlighting our sustainability and employee well-being.

What You'll Do: 

- Design and implement embedded firmware for low-power IoT devices using C/C++ (RTOS or bare-metal)

- Integrate wireless communication technologies such as BLE, LoRa or Cellular

- Design, build and operate cloud-side ingestion pipelines and device fleet management systems for large-scale IoT deployments

- Contribute to the design and deployment of cloud architectures for IoT integrations

- Implement secure and reliable OTA update mechanisms for remote firmware management

- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for firmware and cloud components (e.g. GitHub Actions)

- Collaborate with colleagues across firmware, hardware and cloud teams

- Troubleshoot complex system-level issues across device, connectivity and cloud layers

- Contribute to architecture and process improvements based on emerging best practices

What You'll Bring: 

- Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

- Experience developing embedded firmware in C/C++ (RTOS or bare-metal), with a good understanding of common interfaces (I2C, SPI, UART)

- Experience with wireless protocols (BLE, LoRa or Cellular) and IoT communication protocols and data formats (MQTT, HTTP/REST, CoAP, Protobuf, JSON)

- Experience designing and operating cloud-based ingestion and device fleet management systems for connected IoT devices at scale

- Experience implementing OTA updates in production systems

- Proficiency in a backend language (e.g. Python, Go, Node.js or Java) for device integration, automation and diagnostics, with excellent system-level debugging and problem-solving skills

- Good written and spoken German and English

If you don't meet every requirement but bring relevant experience and skills, we'd still like to hear from you. 

What's In It For You? 

⚡ Flexibility & Balance: Flexible working hours and work-life balance allow you to tailor work to fit your life.

🌟 Recognition & Growth: Opportunities for career advancement in a company that values your contributions.

🌍 Flexible ways of working: Our global teams work across our offices in Zurich, Zug, Hyderabad and Basel, with a mix of on-site, hybrid and remote working. Role-specific locations and working arrangements are detailed above. 

🎉 Company-wide Events: Join us for company events to celebrate successes, build teams, and share our vision. Plus, new joiners experience SkyWeek, our immersive onboarding program.

👶 Generous Maternity & Paternity Leave: Support for new parents with competitive maternity and paternity leave.

🏖️ Annual Leave & Bank Holidays: Enjoy a generous annual leave package, plus local bank holidays to recharge and unwind.

Ready to Make an Impact? 

We’re not just offering a job; we’re offering a chance to be part of something bigger. At SkyCell, you’ll help build a future where pharmaceutical delivery is efficient, sustainable, and transformative.

Stay Connected with SkyCell 

Visit http://www.skycell.ch and explore #WeAreSkyCell on LinkedIn

How to Apply 

Simply click ‘apply for this job’ below! We can’t wait to meet you and discuss how you can contribute to our mission! Please note, we are unable to consider applications sent to us via email.

If you have any questions, you can contact our Talent Team (

title: Senior Hardware Engineer
description:
Team description

You've probably paid for a coffee or tapped your card at a hairdresser using one of our card readers already. Our Hardware team designs and builds the beautifully engineered payment devices and accessories that let millions of small merchants start, run and grow their businesses, spanning industrial design, electronics, embedded systems, mobile apps and backend services. As Senior Hardware Engineer, you'll shape the electrical architecture behind our next generation of products, including new designs built on modern Android platforms, giving you real influence over how SumUp's hardware portfolio takes shape from the very first schematic.

What you'll do

- 
Design and review electrical schematics, defining hardware architectures for new products

- 
Partner with Mechanical Engineering, Android and embedded software, Product and Supply Chain teams to align platform choices, interfaces and product integration

- 
Own hardware delivery from prototyping and bring up through validation and mass production readiness, debugging designs and reducing technical risk along the way

- 
Explore new design approaches and prototype untested concepts to work through tough technical challenges

- 
Lead technical workstreams and design reviews, coordinate implementation across cross functional teams, and mentor colleagues to share hardware engineering knowledge

You'll be great for this role if…

- 
Significant experience in electrical engineering, gained in consumer electronics or hardware product development.

- 
Strong knowledge across several of the following areas: RF (cellular, NFC, Wi-Fi/BT), power design, digital buses and protocols, battery technology or analogue design.

- 
Track record of bringing multiple hardware products through to mass production.

- 
Proficiency in a mainstream CAD system such as Altium or Cadence/Allegro.

- 
Ability to create hardware architectures for modern Android based products and work closely with Android or embedded software teams on platform integration.

Nice to have: 

- 
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, with a Master's a bonus.

- 
Basic coding skills for simple firmware validation, with Android device bring up experience a plus.

title: Senior Embedded Performance Engineer
description:
Auterion builds a cutting-edge operating system for autonomous robotic systems that empower a diverse range of platforms to perform surveillance, reconnaissance, inspection, mapping and logistics tasks. Our industry-leading software drives the adoption of robotic fleets and is recognized by the U.S. government as the future standard for its drone programs. 

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Performance Engineer who is passionate about getting the most out of embedded systems — from low-level Linux tuning and hardware integration to high-performance video and data pipelines.
